AI.conclusion: 有状态的程序化工具调用是构建可扩展工具增强型智能体的一个极具前景的发展方向。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can autonomously run neuroimaging analyses from research questions to reported findings. Existing agentic systems use tools to check that code runs and reported values match its output, but rely on LLM judgment to decide which results warrant scientific reporting. We show that LLM judges endorse site-confounded findings even when the confound is presented as evidence. We present \textbf{CONFIRM}, a framework that separates running an analysis from deciding which findings to report. CONFIRM encodes each hypothesis as a machine-readable, pre-specified analysis plan that fixes the claim and its pass criteria before computing results. It then filters results through five deterministic gates (search history and multiplicity, confounds, power, analytic stability, and replication) under three configurable reporting standards, from least to most demanding: \textit{Screen}, \textit{Replicate}, and \textit{Full}. Failed claims receive diagnoses that guide follow-up analyses. To evaluate reporting decisions at the claim level, we introduce \textbf{NeuroClaimBench}, comprising 489 executable neuroimaging claims with frozen data, including literature-supported findings and 150 controls designed to violate individual methodological requirements. On NeuroClaimBench, CONFIRM falsely supports at most 3\% of controls, compared with 23--38\% for the baselines, while recovering up to 61\% of literature-supported claims. When auditing an existing agent, CONFIRM reduces false support on controls from 23\% to 0\% while retaining the agent's literature-supported claims. Its diagnostic feedback also produces more supported revisions than Self-Refine with fewer LLM calls. Together, CONFIRM and NeuroClaimBench show that basing reporting decisions on pre-specified analysis plans and deterministic gates is essential for trustworthy autonomous scientific discovery.
title: CONFIRM: Governing Scientific Reporting for Trustworthy Agentic Neuroimaging

AI.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以自主运行从研究问题到报告发现的神经影像分析。现有的智能体系统使用工具来检查代码是否运行以及报告的值是否与其输出匹配，但依赖LLM的判断来决定哪些结果值得进行科学报告。我们表明，即使将混杂因素作为证据呈现，LLM评判者也会认可存在位点混杂的发现。我们提出了CONFIRM，这是一个将运行分析与决定报告哪些发现分离开来的框架。CONFIRM将每个假设编码为机器可读的、预先指定的分析计划，在计算结果之前固定声明及其通过标准。然后，它在三种可配置的报告标准（从要求最低到最高：Screen、Replicate和Full）下，通过五个确定性门控（搜索历史和多重性、混杂因素、统计功效、分析稳定性和可重复性）对结果进行过滤。失败的声明会收到指导后续分析的诊断。为了在声明级别评估报告决策，我们引入了NeuroClaimBench，包含489个具有冻结数据的可执行神经影像声明，包括文献支持的发现和150个旨在违反各个方法学要求的对照。在NeuroClaimBench上，CONFIRM最多错误支持3%的对照，而基线方法为23-38%，同时恢复了高达61%的文献支持的声明。在审计现有智能体时，CONFIRM将对照的错误支持率从23%降低到0%，同时保留了智能体文献支持的声明。其诊断反馈也比Self-Refine产生更多受支持的修订，且LLM调用次数更少。总而言之，CONFIRM和NeuroClaimBench表明，将报告决策基于预先指定的分析计划和确定性门控对于值得信赖的自主科学发现至关重要。
AI.tldr: 提出CONFIRM框架和NeuroClaimBench基准，通过预先指定的分析计划和确定性门控来规范LLM智能体的神经影像分析报告决策，显著降低了错误支持率并提高了自主科学发现的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体系统依赖LLM的判断来决定哪些结果值得报告，但LLM容易认可存在位点混杂等缺陷的发现，导致科学报告不可靠。
AI.method: 提出CONFIRM框架，将分析运行与报告决策分离。将假设编码为预先指定的分析计划，并通过五个确定性门控（搜索历史与多重性、混杂因素、统计功效、分析稳定性和可重复性）在三种报告标准下过滤结果。同时引入NeuroClaimBench基准，包含489个冻结数据的可执行神经影像声明（含文献支持发现和违规对照）用于评估。
AI.result: 在NeuroClaimBench上，CONFIRM对对照组的错误支持率最高仅为3%（基线为23-38%），并恢复了高达61%的文献支持声明。在审计现有智能体时，将对照组的错误支持率从23%降至0%，且其诊断反馈比Self-Refine产生更多有效修订，同时减少了LLM调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 将报告决策建立在预先指定的分析计划和确定性门控之上，对于实现值得信赖的自主科学发现至关重要。

comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 AgenticLS Workshop; adds one experiment
summary: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the agent on healthy hardware. Across eight SciFact batches, Qwen3.5-4B shows repeatable citation changes in three capture-claim combinations, and Gemma 3 4B IT shows repeatable read and citation changes in four. These seven combinations cover two claims. Full restoration recovers the reference evidence sets while verdicts remain unchanged. Verdict changes observed under the baseline prompt did not recur under the explicit-example prompt. Complementary tool and optimizer experiments distinguish recovery of numerical state, recovery of ranked lists, and restoration of an agent's visible history. These results show that an audit should track both the evidence an agent uses and its final answer. In hERG cardiac-safety assay allocation, silent numerical faults changed testing decisions while the fixed-budget shortlist kept the same number of compounds labeled as blockers. After the agent had used faulty values, restoring its earlier execution state and supplying certified scores recovered all 39 changed decisions, whereas replacing the prediction file recovered none; no incorrect action was committed. A streaming implementation of the arithmetic checks reduced the total time for forward execution and verification by 42.4% relative to the original FP64 implementation, with identical flags and recovery outputs.
title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents

selection.reason_zh: 研究科学agent的决策溯源审计，通过恢复工具状态和执行历史来追踪证据链，其状态追踪与审计方法对coding agent的可靠性验证有参考价值

AI.abstract_zh: 科学智能体在读取和引用不同证据时可能会给出相同的裁决。BioAgent-DF使用在同一科学计算站点保存的成对参考值和候选值来测试这种分离。它在原始坐标处恢复或移植这些值，然后在健康硬件上运行智能体。在八个SciFact批次中，Qwen3.5-4B在三个捕获-声明组合中显示出可重复的引用变化，而Gemma 3 4B IT在四个组合中显示出可重复的读取和引用变化。这七个组合涵盖了两个声明。完全恢复可以恢复参考证据集，同时裁决保持不变。在基线提示下观察到的裁决变化在显式示例提示下没有再次出现。补充的工具和优化器实验区分了数值状态的恢复、排序列表的恢复以及智能体可见历史的恢复。这些结果表明，审计应同时跟踪智能体使用的证据及其最终答案。在hERG心脏安全性测定分配中，静默数值故障改变了测试决策，而固定预算的候选名单保持了相同数量的被标记为阻断剂的化合物。在智能体使用故障值之后，恢复其早期执行状态并提供认证分数恢复了所有39个更改的决策，而替换预测文件则没有恢复任何决策；没有执行不正确的操作。算术检查的流式实现将前向执行和验证的总时间相对于原始FP64实现减少了42.4%，同时具有相同的标志和恢复输出。
AI.tldr: 本文提出BioAgent-DF框架，通过恢复和移植科学计算中的数值状态，揭示了科学智能体在证据引用与最终裁决间的分离现象，并证明了状态恢复在修复静默数值故障和审计智能体决策中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体可能在读取和引用不同证据时给出相同的裁决，且静默数值故障可能导致错误的测试决策，因此需要一种方法来测试这种分离现象并审计和恢复智能体的执行状态与证据使用。
AI.method: 提出BioAgent-DF框架，利用同一计算站点保存的成对参考值和候选值，在原始坐标处恢复或移植数值并在健康硬件上运行智能体。结合补充工具和优化器实验区分数值状态、排序列表和可见历史的恢复，并采用流式实现进行算术检查。
AI.result: 在SciFact批次中，Qwen3.5-4B和Gemma 3 4B IT表现出可重复的引用和读取变化；完全恢复能恢复证据集而裁决不变。在hERG测定中，恢复早期执行状态和认证分数成功恢复了因静默数值故障改变的39个决策，而替换预测文件无效。流式算术检查使总时间减少42.4%。
AI.conclusion: 对科学智能体的审计必须同时跟踪其使用的证据和最终答案。通过恢复早期执行状态和提供认证分数，可以有效纠正由静默数值故障引起的决策错误，且流式算术检查能显著提升验证效率。

summary: The proliferation of Large Language Models has catalyzed powerful application development platforms like Dify, which enable users to build sophisticated LLM-powered workflows through modular node orchestration. However, manually configuring these workflows requires deep platform expertise and remains time-consuming and error-prone, creating a significant barrier for non-expert users. To address this challenge, we propose \textsc{ChatDify}, a novel multi-agent framework that automates end-to-end Dify workflow synthesis from natural language descriptions. \textsc{ChatDify} employs an Actor-Critic architecture comprising three specialized agents: the \textit{Planner Agent} that decomposes user requests into structured execution plans, the \textit{Executor Agent} that performs context-aware parameter synthesis and schema-augmented DSL compilation, and the \textit{Reviewer Agent} that ensures reliability through hybrid verification with closed-loop refinement. We evaluate \textsc{ChatDify} on a curated benchmark of 100 production-inspired tasks across three state-of-the-art LLM backends, achieving 0.96, 0.91, and 0.75 success rates with Qwen-3.7, GLM-5.1, and DeepSeek-v4, respectively. These results demonstrate its robustness and practical applicability for lowering the technical barrier to creating sophisticated LLM applications.
title: \textsc{ChatDify}: Automating End-to-End Dify Workflow Synthesis from Natural Language via Multi-Agent Collaboration

selection.reason_zh: 提出多agent协作自动合成Dify工作流的框架，包含Planner/Executor/Reviewer的Actor-Critic架构和闭环验证，其多agent协作与DSL编译方法可迁移到代码优化agent设计

AI.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型的普及催生了像Dify这样强大的应用开发平台，使用户能够通过模块化节点编排构建复杂的LLM驱动的工作流。然而，手动配置这些工作流需要深厚的平台专业知识，且耗时且容易出错，为非专家用户造成了重大障碍。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了\textsc{ChatDify}，一种新颖的多智能体框架，可从自然语言描述中自动化端到端的Dify工作流合成。\textsc{ChatDify}采用包含三个专用智能体的Actor-Critic架构：将用户请求分解为结构化执行计划的\textit{Planner Agent}，执行上下文感知参数合成和模式增强DSL编译的\textit{Executor Agent}，以及通过混合验证与闭环细化确保可靠性的\textit{Reviewer Agent}。我们在包含100个源自生产环境的任务的精选基准上评估了\textsc{ChatDify}，跨越三个最先进的LLM后端，使用Qwen-3.7、GLM-5.1和DeepSeek-v4分别达到了0.96、0.91和0.75的成功率。这些结果证明了其在降低创建复杂LLM应用的技术门槛方面的鲁棒性和实际适用性。
AI.tldr: 提出ChatDify，一个基于Actor-Critic架构的多智能体框架，通过自然语言描述自动生成Dify工作流，显著降低了非专家用户构建复杂LLM应用的技术门槛。
AI.motivation: 手动配置Dify等LLM工作流平台需要深厚的专业知识，且过程耗时、易错，对非专家用户构成了显著的技术壁垒。
AI.method: 提出ChatDify多智能体框架，采用Actor-Critic架构，包含三个专用智能体：负责分解请求的Planner Agent、负责参数合成与DSL编译的Executor Agent，以及通过混合验证和闭环细化确保可靠性的Reviewer Agent。
AI.result: 在100个源自生产环境的任务基准测试中，结合Qwen-3.7、GLM-5.1和DeepSeek-v4三种LLM后端，分别取得了0.96、0.91和0.75的工作流合成成功率。
AI.conclusion: ChatDify具有高度的鲁棒性和实用性，能够有效降低构建复杂LLM应用的技术门槛。

comment: The paper is accepted by Neurips 2026 Position Track
summary: A common assumption in chain-of-thought (CoT) oversight is that a visible reasoning trace makes model behavior easier to monitor. We argue that this assumption can conflate distinct properties along a chain linking a model's internal computation, reasoning artifacts, outputs, and monitor judgments. We identify four properties along this chain: reasoning visibility (whether a trace is accessible), mechanistic faithfulness (whether a trace reflects internal computation), mechanistic localizability (whether a compact causal mechanism can be isolated), and behavioral monitorability (whether a monitor can detect the target behavior). Two complementary case studies across three open-weight reasoning models show why these distinctions matter. In the security vulnerability reasoning study, probes and activation ablations provide evidence of internal representation and causal influence, but a monitor with access to the reference answer does not outperform the majority-class baseline in a held-out test. In authority-hint factual reasoning study, a monitor correctly distinguishes changed from unchanged answers, but seven mechanistic analyses do not isolate a compact causal mechanism. These results show that evidence for one claim does not establish the others. We therefore propose an evidential-chain reporting standard. Each claim carries a licensing statement that specifies its target property, access tier, and artifact, and labels each required link as supported, unsupported, or assumed. These assessments determine whether the conclusion is licensed, conditionally licensed, or not licensed.
title: Chain-of-Thought Oversight Requires Separate Evidence for Faithfulness and Monitorability

selection.reason_zh: 提出CoT监督的证据链报告标准，区分推理可见性、机制忠实性与行为可监控性，对理解和监控coding agent推理过程的可靠性有启发

AI.abstract_zh: 思维链（CoT）监督中的一个常见假设是，可见的推理轨迹使模型行为更容易被监控。我们认为，这一假设可能会混淆连接模型内部计算、推理产物、输出和监控判断的链条上的不同属性。我们识别出该链条上的四个属性：推理可见性（轨迹是否可访问）、机制忠实性（轨迹是否反映内部计算）、机制局部性（是否可以隔离出紧凑的因果机制）以及行为可监控性（监控器是否能检测到目标行为）。在三个开放权重推理模型上进行的两个互补案例研究表明，为什么这些区分很重要。在安全漏洞推理研究中，探测器和激活消融提供了内部表示和因果影响的证据，但能够访问参考答案的监控器在留出测试中的表现并未超过多数类基线。在权威提示事实推理研究中，监控器能够正确区分已更改和未更改的答案，但七项机制分析均未能隔离出紧凑的因果机制。这些结果表明，一个主张的证据并不能确立其他主张。因此，我们提出了一种证据链报告标准。每个主张都附带一个许可声明，指定其目标属性、访问层级和产物，并将每个必需的链接标记为受支持、不受支持或假设。这些评估决定了结论是受许可、有条件受许可还是不受许可。
AI.tldr: 本文指出思维链监督中“可见推理轨迹易于监控”的假设混淆了推理可见性、机制忠实性、机制局部性和行为可监控性四个不同属性，并通过案例研究证明这些属性间缺乏必然联系，进而提出了一种规范化的证据链报告标准。
AI.motivation: 思维链（CoT）监督中普遍存在一种假设，即认为可见的推理轨迹能让模型行为更容易被监控。作者认为该假设混淆了模型内部计算到监控判断链条上的多个不同属性，需要明确区分这些属性以准确评估模型的可监控性。
AI.method: 作者首先定义了推理链条上的四个属性：推理可见性、机制忠实性、机制局部性和行为可监控性。随后，在三个开放权重推理模型上开展了两项互补的案例研究（安全漏洞推理和权威提示事实推理），利用探针、激活消融和机制分析等方法，分别评估了这些属性在实际模型中的表现及其相互关系。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，针对某一属性的证据无法证明其他属性。在安全漏洞推理中，内部表示和因果影响有证据支持，但监控器表现未超越基线；在事实推理中，监控器能区分答案变化，但机制分析未能隔离出紧凑的因果机制。
AI.conclusion: 证据链上的不同属性（如可见性、忠实性、局部性、可监控性）不能相互替代或推导。为此，作者提出了一种证据链报告标准，要求对每个主张明确其目标属性、访问层级和产物，并标记链接的支持状态，从而严格界定结论的许可级别。

summary: B2B outbound sales involves high transaction values and relationship-based trust, so closing a deal typically requires multiple rounds of outreach building on prior context. Existing LLM-based sales agents operate within single sessions and cannot carry forward context or refine strategies from experience. Methods that do learn from experience store lessons as unstructured text and treat all outcomes as equally informative, with no mechanism to distinguish a flawed strategy from an external factor. We propose SPAR, a self-evolving framework that models selling strategies as testable hypotheses and refines them without parameter updates. A double-loop architecture lets an inner loop adapt to individual merchants through episodic memory while an outer loop evolves a shared strategy playbook through causal attribution and hypothesis-driven evolution. In a live A/B test on the 1688 platform with over 200,000 merchants, SPAR achieves +15.8% conversion lift and +35.8% high-intent merchant growth. Human evaluation by domain experts rates SPAR at 4.62 out of 5 on overall sales quality, the highest among all methods.
title: SPAR: Experience-Driven Strategy Evolution in Multi-Session B2B Sales

selection.reason_zh: 提出双循环架构，内环用情景记忆适应个体、外环通过因果归因和假设驱动演化共享策略，经验复用与自我改进机制可迁移到agent设计

AI.abstract_zh: B2B外呼销售涉及高交易价值和基于关系的信任，因此达成交易通常需要多轮基于先前上下文的外呼沟通。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的销售代理在单一会话中运行，无法延续上下文或从经验中优化策略。确实能从经验中学习的方法将经验存储为非结构化文本，并将所有结果视为具有同等的信息量，缺乏区分策略缺陷与外部因素的机制。我们提出了SPAR，一个自我进化的框架，它将销售策略建模为可测试的假设，并在不更新参数的情况下对其进行优化。双循环架构让内循环通过情景记忆适应单个商家，而外循环通过因果归因和假设驱动的进化来发展共享的策略手册。在1688平台上针对超过200,000个商家的实时A/B测试中，SPAR实现了+15.8%的转化率提升和+35.8%的高意向商家增长。领域专家的人工评估对SPAR的整体销售质量评分为5分中的4.62分，在所有方法中得分最高。
AI.tldr: 提出SPAR框架，通过双循环架构和假设驱动的策略进化，解决现有LLM销售代理缺乏上下文延续和经验优化能力的问题，在1688平台的大规模A/B测试中显著提升了转化率和销售质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的销售代理受限于单一会话，无法延续上下文或从经验中优化策略；而现有的经验学习方法将经验存为非结构化文本且无法区分策略缺陷与外部因素，导致无法有效指导B2B多轮外呼销售。
AI.method: 提出SPAR自我进化框架，将销售策略建模为可测试假设。采用双循环架构：内循环利用情景记忆适应单个商家；外循环通过因果归因和假设驱动进化来优化共享策略手册，全程无需更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在1688平台超200,000个商家的实时A/B测试中，SPAR实现转化率提升15.8%，高意向商家增长35.8%。领域专家人工评估其整体销售质量得分为4.62/5，位居所有方法之首。
AI.conclusion: SPAR框架通过无参数更新的双循环假设驱动进化机制，有效解决了B2B销售中上下文延续与策略优化的难题，显著提升了实际业务中的转化效率与销售质量。

summary: AI agents often rely on persistent memory to retain user preferences and operational rules across sessions. However, this capability introduces a new safety risk: malicious instructions from messages, documents, or Web content can be retained in memory and influence future tasks even after the original attack content is removed. Existing attack success metrics, however, fail to capture who is affected and how attacks translate into downstream harm during otherwise normal task execution. We introduce MemHarmBench, a victim-centric benchmark for evaluating cross-session prompt injection in memory-persistent AI agents. MemHarmBench considers three categories of potential victims: users, workspace/project owners, and external stakeholders. Our evaluation first exposes an agent to malicious instructions and tests whether they are retained in memory. We then remove the attack content and initiate a new session with a legitimate task while preserving the agent's memory. We jointly evaluate whether the agent follows the attacker's intent, completes the legitimate task, and exhibits observable execution anomalies. Across multiple agent systems, we find that cross-session attacks can remain behaviorally stealthy: agents often complete tasks normally and exhibit no detectable anomalies while still making critical decisions aligned with the attacker's intent. By connecting malicious memory retention to downstream decisions and affected parties, MemHarmBench provides a systematic framework for exposing safety risks that conventional attack- and task-success metrics may overlook. We publicly release MemHarmBench at https://github.com/Kirito14IT/MemHarmBench.
title: MemHarmBench: Evaluating Cross-Session Prompt Injection in Memory-Persistent AI Agents

selection.reason_zh: 提出针对记忆持久化agent的跨会话prompt注入安全benchmark，评估恶意记忆如何影响下游决策，对coding agent的长期记忆安全控制有直接参考价值

AI.abstract_zh: AI智能体通常依赖持久化记忆来跨会话保留用户偏好和操作规则。然而，这种能力引入了一个新的安全风险：来自消息、文档或网页内容的恶意指令可以被保留在记忆中，并在原始攻击内容被移除后继续影响未来的任务。然而，现有的攻击成功指标未能捕捉到谁受到了影响，以及攻击如何在原本正常的任务执行过程中转化为下游危害。我们引入了MemHarmBench，这是一个以受害者为中心的基准，用于评估具有记忆持久性的AI智能体中的跨会话提示词注入。MemHarmBench考虑了三类潜在的受害者：用户、工作区/项目所有者和外部利益相关者。我们的评估首先使智能体暴露于恶意指令，并测试它们是否被保留在记忆中。然后，我们移除攻击内容，并在保留智能体记忆的同时启动一个包含合法任务的新会话。我们联合评估智能体是否遵循了攻击者的意图、是否完成了合法任务，以及是否表现出可观察的执行异常。在多个智能体系统中，我们发现跨会话攻击可以在行为上保持隐蔽：智能体通常能正常完成任务且不表现出可检测的异常，同时仍然做出符合攻击者意图的关键决策。通过将恶意记忆保留与下游决策和受影响方联系起来，MemHarmBench提供了一个系统性的框架，用于揭示传统攻击和任务成功指标可能忽略的安全风险。我们在 https://github.com/Kirito14IT/MemHarmBench 公开发布了MemHarmBench。
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MemHarmBench，一个以受害者为中心的基准测试，用于评估具有持久化记忆的AI智能体在跨会话提示词注入攻击下的安全风险，揭示了攻击者能在智能体正常执行任务的同时隐蔽地操纵其关键决策。
AI.motivation: 现有的攻击成功指标无法有效衡量跨会话提示词注入攻击中具体受影响的群体，以及攻击如何在正常任务执行中转化为下游危害，缺乏针对记忆持久化AI智能体的系统性安全评估框架。
AI.method: 提出MemHarmBench基准，定义用户、项目所有者和外部利益相关者三类受害者。评估流程包括：首先让智能体接触恶意指令并测试记忆保留情况；随后移除攻击内容并开启合法任务的新会话；最后联合评估智能体是否遵从攻击意图、完成合法任务以及是否存在执行异常。
AI.result: 在多个智能体系统中，跨会话攻击能够保持行为上的隐蔽性。智能体在正常完成合法任务且无明显执行异常的情况下，依然会做出符合攻击者意图的关键决策。
AI.conclusion: MemHarmBench通过将恶意记忆保留与下游决策及受影响方相连接，提供了一个系统性框架，有效揭示了传统指标容易忽略的AI智能体安全风险。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skill libraries to support complex task execution. However, determining which skills are needed remains challenging in long-horizon tasks. Existing methods typically select a fixed skill set before execution, implicitly assuming that a task's procedural requirements can be determined from its initial description. This assumption is restrictive for long-horizon interaction, where new requirements emerge from intermediate observations, execution outcomes, and newly revealed constraints. This motivates just-in-time skill retrieval, which dynamically selects skills as execution unfolds. Just-in-time skill retrieval is promising but challenging: the utility of a skill depends not only on the current context, but also on the evolving task state shaped by prior steps. To this end, we propose JitSkill, a state-grounded framework that addresses this challenge through continuous task-state tracking. By connecting emerging requirements with accumulated task progress, JitSkill provides procedural support throughout execution without treating each retrieval decision independently. Experiments across three agent benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness in improving long-horizon task completion. Our code is available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/JitSkill.git/.
title: Just-in-Time Skill Retrieval via Long-Horizon State Tracking

AI.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖外部技能库来支持复杂任务的执行。然而，在长期任务中，确定需要哪些技能仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常在执行前选择固定的技能集，隐含地假设任务的程序性需求可以从其初始描述中确定。这种假设对于长期交互来说具有局限性，因为在长期交互中，新的需求会从中间观察、执行结果和新揭示的约束中涌现。这促使了即时技能检索的发展，即在执行过程中动态选择技能。即时技能检索很有前景但也充满挑战：技能的效用不仅取决于当前上下文，还取决于由先前步骤塑造的不断演变的任务状态。为此，我们提出了JitSkill，这是一个基于状态的框架，通过持续的任务状态跟踪来应对这一挑战。通过将新兴需求与累积的任务进度相连接，JitSkill在整个执行过程中提供程序性支持，而不会将每次检索决策独立对待。在三个智能体基准测试上的实验证明了其在提高长期任务完成率方面的有效性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/JitSkill.git/ 获取。
AI.tldr: 提出JitSkill框架，通过持续的任务状态跟踪实现大型语言模型智能体在长期任务中的即时技能动态检索，有效提升了复杂任务的完成率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在长期任务中预先固定技能集，无法应对执行过程中因中间观察、执行结果和新约束而涌现的新需求。因此需要一种能够根据不断演变的任务状态动态进行即时技能检索的方法。
AI.method: 提出JitSkill框架，这是一种基于状态的框架。它通过持续的任务状态跟踪，将执行过程中涌现的新需求与累积的任务进度相连接，从而在不孤立每次检索决策的情况下，为整个执行过程提供动态的程序性技能支持。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准测试上的实验表明，JitSkill能够有效提高长期任务的完成率。
AI.conclusion: 基于持续任务状态跟踪的即时技能检索框架JitSkill，能够有效解决长期任务中动态技能选择的难题，显著提升智能体执行复杂长期任务的能力。

summary: Task success, retrieval quality, and cost do not show whether an LLM agent used a delivered memory or what followed from that use. We introduce MemUse, which evaluates memory at its point of use in recorded trajectories: each memory delivery is compared with what the agent could already see and followed through the agent's later actions and their consequences. An agentic judge rates each delivered entry's relevance, accuracy, novelty, influence, and observed effect; programmatic checks enforce complete reading of cited evidence, and fixed rules aggregate the ratings into verdicts linked to memory histories and delivery cost. On 8,000 SWE-bench Verified episodes from three memory systems, resolve rates stay within 0.4 percentage points of a no-memory baseline, yet MemUse shows that most delivered entries were irrelevant, most relevant entries went unused, and in two systems most deliveries restated content the agent could still see. It also surfaces effects that outcomes hide: 23.2\% of episodes with beneficial memory use still failed, and 5 of 16 with harmful use still succeeded.
title: Delivered, Not Used: Evaluating Agent Memory at Its Point of Use

AI.abstract_zh: 任务成功率、检索质量和成本并不能表明大型语言模型智能体是否使用了传递的记忆，以及使用该记忆后产生了什么结果。我们引入了MemUse，它在记录的轨迹中评估记忆的使用点：将每次记忆传递与智能体已经看到的内容进行比较，并追踪智能体后续的行动及其后果。一个智能体评判者对每个传递条目的相关性、准确性、新颖性、影响力和观察到的效果进行评分；程序化检查强制要求完整阅读引用的证据，固定规则将评分汇总为与记忆历史和传递成本相关联的裁决。在来自三个记忆系统的8,000个SWE-bench Verified片段中，解决率保持在无记忆基线的0.4个百分点以内，然而MemUse显示，大多数传递的条目是不相关的，大多数相关条目未被使用，并且在两个系统中，大多数传递只是重述了智能体仍然可以看到的内容。它还揭示了结果所隐藏的影响：23.2%具有有益记忆使用的片段仍然失败了，而16个具有有害使用的片段中有5个仍然成功了。

summary: Agentic workflows organize complex tasks into reusable procedures. However, invoking an LLM at every step incurs repeated inference costs and delays. We propose a framework for self-evolving agentic workflows through semantic task decomposition. Each subtask has explicit applicability conditions and a procedure that executes code or invokes a model as needed. An agent uses execution feedback to refine the decomposition and update these procedures. Experiments in the GLEE competition show the framework on bargaining, negotiation and persuasion. Most observed final-decision procedures are implemented in code. Code is available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow.
title: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows via Semantic Decomposition of Complex Tasks

AI.abstract_zh: 代理工作流将复杂任务组织成可重用的过程。然而，在每一步调用大语言模型会产生重复的推理成本和延迟。我们提出了一种通过语义任务分解实现自进化代理工作流的框架。每个子任务都有明确的适用条件，以及一个根据需要执行代码或调用模型的过程。代理使用执行反馈来细化分解并更新这些过程。在GLEE竞赛中的实验展示了该框架在讨价还价、谈判和说服方面的应用。观察到的大多数最终决策过程都是用代码实现的。代码可在 https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/NeurIPS2026_SeaFlow 获取。

AI.motivation: 现有的代理工作流在每一步都调用大语言模型（LLM），导致重复的推理成本和高延迟。
AI.method: 提出一种基于语义任务分解的自进化代理工作流框架。为每个子任务定义明确的适用条件和执行过程（按需执行代码或调用模型），并利用执行反馈来细化任务分解和更新执行过程。

summary: Long-horizon terminal tasks are used to evaluate and train agents. Human-curated datasets are scarce, so many synthesis methods have emerged. They usually measure the length of a task by the turns a model needs to pass it, and its difficulty by labels the LLM sets during generation. We find, however, that the turn count largely reflects the habits of the model, not only the demands of the task, and that the labels barely track how often models pass. We describe a terminal task by its work, the number of operations it requires, and its depth, the number of turns that must happen in sequence because the commands of each turn can only be chosen after reading the output of the previous one. Estimating depth as the smallest turn cap, stated to the agent, under which the task passes, we audit 734 tasks from six existing datasets. Synthesis has mostly added work, not depth: 94% of the solved synthetic tasks pass within three turns, yet depth, unlike the turn count, predicts difficulty beyond work. We propose DEPTH, in which a generation agent writes each task one segment at a time in a real software environment, carrying out each segment before writing it and starting the next from the state it leaves. Our 105 tasks exceed every audited dataset in depth and work, and none of six current models passes half of them. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on runs from these tasks improves it on two terminal benchmarks.
title: Is Your Long-Horizon Benchmark Really Deep? Measuring and Synthesizing Depth in Terminal Tasks

selection.reason_zh: 深入研究长程终端任务（如 bash/代码执行）的深度与难度，提出在真实软件环境中合成高深度 agent 评测 benchmark 的方法，直接相关于 coding agent 的评测与长程任务。

AI.abstract_zh: 长视野终端任务被用于评估和训练智能体。由于人工策划的数据集很稀缺，因此出现了许多合成方法。它们通常通过模型通过任务所需的回合数来衡量任务的长度，并通过大语言模型在生成过程中设置的标签来衡量其难度。然而，我们发现回合数在很大程度上反映的是模型的习惯，而不仅仅是任务的需求，并且这些标签几乎无法追踪模型通过的频率。我们通过任务的工作量（其所需的操作数量）和深度（必须按顺序发生的回合数量，因为每个回合的命令只能在读取上一回合的输出后才能选择）来描述终端任务。我们将深度估计为向智能体声明的最小回合上限，在该上限下任务能够通过，并据此审计了来自六个现有数据集的734个任务。合成主要增加了工作量，而不是深度：94%的已解决合成任务在三个回合内通过，然而与回合数不同，深度能预测超出工作量的难度。我们提出了DEPTH方法，其中生成智能体在真实的软件环境中逐段编写每个任务，在编写下一段之前先执行当前段，并从其执行后留下的状态开始编写下一段。我们的105个任务在深度和工作量上超过了所有被审计的数据集，并且当前六个模型中没有一个能通过其中一半的任务。在这些任务的运行数据上对Qwen3-8B进行微调，提高了其在两个终端基准测试上的表现。
AI.tldr: 本文指出当前长视野终端任务合成方法在衡量任务长度和难度上的缺陷，提出了基于“工作量”和“深度”的新评估指标，并设计了DEPTH方法在真实软件环境中逐段执行生成高深度任务，显著提升了智能体在终端基准测试上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有长视野终端任务合成方法使用“回合数”衡量任务长度、用“LLM标签”衡量难度，但这实际上反映的是模型习惯而非真实任务需求，且无法准确预测任务难度。此外，现有合成方法主要增加了任务的工作量而非深度，导致任务缺乏真正的长视野挑战。
AI.method: 1. 提出用“工作量”（操作总数）和“深度”（必须严格顺序执行的回合数）来重新定义和评估终端任务。2. 审计了6个现有数据集的734个任务，验证深度比回合数更能预测难度。3. 提出DEPTH生成方法：生成智能体在真实软件环境中逐段编写任务，每写完一段即在环境中执行，并基于执行后的真实状态继续编写下一段，从而确保任务的高深度和高工作量。
AI.result: 1. 审计发现94%的现有合成任务在3个回合内即可通过，合成主要增加了工作量而非深度。2. 深度指标比回合数更能准确预测超出工作量之外的任务难度。3. 使用DEPTH方法生成的105个新任务在深度和工作量上均超越所有现有数据集，6个主流模型均无法通过其中一半的任务。4. 使用这些新任务的运行数据微调Qwen3-8B模型，显著提升了其在两个终端基准测试上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 传统的回合数和标签无法准确衡量长视野终端任务的真实难度。通过引入“深度”和“工作量”指标，并在真实软件环境中采用逐段执行的DEPTH生成方法，可以构建出真正具备高深度挑战的终端任务数据集，从而有效评估并提升大语言模型智能体的长视野任务能力。

summary: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. We further introduce TriPhys, a framework that learns a unified policy for physical perception, knowledge retrieval, and quantitative reasoning from complete tool-integrated trajectories. The policy uses intermediate reasoning to guide retrieval and computation, then incorporates tool feedback into subsequent physical inference. On 110 questions from videos excluded from training, TriPhys improves answer and solution scores across three Qwen configurations, with a 17.7% relative gain in answer accuracy for TriPhys-27B over its Qwen3.6-27B backbone. This work provides a benchmark and a learning pathway toward embodied agents that move beyond recognizing events to understanding and reasoning about the physical processes behind them.
title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents

selection.reason_zh: 提出具身 agent 物理智能评测基准及基于工具集成轨迹和中间推理的统一策略框架，其工具反馈与推理机制对通用 agent 设计有一定迁移价值。

AI.abstract_zh: 具身智能体需要物理智能，通过物理感知、物理知识检索和物理推理来理解周围环境。这些能力必须协同工作以解释事件并做出定量判断。现有的基准测试推进了物理理解和通用工具的使用，但在物理场景中这些能力的协调仍未得到充分表征。受波普尔“三个世界”理论的启发，我们引入了TriPhysBench，这是一个包含来自200个视频的410个问题的基准测试，将物理感知、物理知识检索和物理推理置于一个共享的评估环境中。其基于测量的和基于知识的子任务对获取观察结果和获取外部规范提出了互补的要求，然后将它们应用于定量问题。在六个具有代表性的视觉语言模型中，表现最好的模型仅达到50.38%的回答准确率，揭示了在需要这些能力协同工作的任务中性能有限。我们进一步引入了TriPhys，这是一个从完整的工具集成轨迹中学习物理感知、知识检索和定量推理的统一策略的框架。该策略使用中间推理来指导检索和计算，然后将工具反馈纳入后续的物理推理中。在训练集之外的110个视频问题中，TriPhys在三种Qwen配置中提高了回答和解答分数，其中TriPhys-27B在其Qwen3.6-27B主干网络的基础上实现了17.7%的回答准确率相对提升。这项工作提供了一个基准测试和一条学习路径，使具身智能体能够超越单纯的事件识别，进而理解和推理其背后的物理过程。
AI.tldr: 本文提出了TriPhysBench基准测试和TriPhys框架，旨在评估和提升具身智能体在物理感知、知识检索与物理推理方面的协同能力，显著提高了视觉语言模型在复杂物理定量问题上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试虽然提升了物理理解和工具使用能力，但未能充分表征和评估这些能力在物理场景中的协同作用。具身智能体需要整合物理感知、知识检索和物理推理来解释事件并进行定量判断，而现有模型在此类综合任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 1. 提出TriPhysBench基准：包含200个视频的410个问题，评估物理感知、知识检索和推理的协同能力，包含基于测量和基于知识的子任务。2. 提出TriPhys框架：从完整的工具集成轨迹中学习统一策略，利用中间推理指导检索与计算，并将工具反馈融入后续物理推理中。
AI.result: 在TriPhysBench上，6个代表性视觉语言模型的最佳准确率仅为50.38%。在110个测试问题上，TriPhys框架在三种Qwen配置下均提升了回答和解答分数，其中TriPhys-27B相比其Qwen3.6-27B主干网络，回答准确率相对提升了17.7%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供的基准测试和学习路径，有助于推动具身智能体从单纯的事件识别向理解和推理底层物理过程迈进。

summary: Efficient GPU kernels are typically low-level and hardware-specific, and LLM agents can now generate them faster than experts can verify. Existing approaches rely on testing, which provides evidence but not a guarantee of correctness. We introduce LARK, an agentic framework that automatically and formally verifies GPU kernels against their PyTorch reference implementations. LARK proves equivalence in functional and memory behavior under exact arithmetic and establishes a new trust boundary: human effort is only needed to verify operator-level Lean semantics ahead of kernel generation time, instead of checking every single line of generated code. LARK formalizes the GPU machine model and the semantics of each operation in Lean 4 once per target language, and the Lean 4 semantics of any incoming kernel is derived from these pre-built definitions. LLM agents then automate the proof in two steps. First, an agent decomposes the whole kernel semantics into smaller segments and Lean 4 verifies this segmentation, which addresses the intractability of proving equivalence for large kernels directly. Second, agents write Lean proofs that each kernel segment matches its high-level PyTorch counterpart. Together, the two steps give whole-program equivalence. We demonstrate that LARK can be used 1) to ensure correctness in existing code-generation agents and 2) to automatically verify human-written kernel libraries. On the KernelCraft GPU tasks, combined with a simple ReAct agent, LARK enables GLM 5.3 to fully verify 10 of 12 Level-1 kernels and Opus 5.5 all 5 Level-2 kernels. Moreover, over 10 production kernels randomly sampled from popular open-source LLM serving frameworks, LARK verifies 9 and identifies a new data race bug in the tenth. We believe LARK represents a significant step toward verifiable code generation in the agentic era.
title: LARK: Lean-Assisted Reasoning for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels

selection.reason_zh: LARK框架使用Lean 4对LLM生成的GPU kernel进行形式化验证，直接涉及coding agent的代码生成与验证，包含agent分解证明、工具反馈等机制，与SemOpt高度相关

AI.abstract_zh: 高效的GPU内核通常是底层且特定于硬件的，而大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在生成它们的速度比专家验证的速度还要快。现有方法依赖于测试，这提供了证据但不能保证正确性。我们引入了LARK，一个智能体框架，能够自动且形式化地验证GPU内核与其PyTorch参考实现的等价性。LARK在精确算术下证明了功能和内存行为的等价性，并建立了一个新的信任边界：人类只需在内核生成前验证算子级别的Lean语义，而不需要检查生成的每一行代码。LARK在Lean 4中针对每种目标语言形式化一次GPU机器模型和每个操作的语义，任何传入内核的Lean 4语义都从这些预构建的定义中推导出来。然后，LLM智能体通过两个步骤自动化证明过程。首先，智能体将整个内核语义分解为更小的片段，Lean 4验证这种分解，这解决了直接证明大型内核等价性的难处理问题。其次，智能体编写Lean证明，证明每个内核片段与其高级PyTorch对应部分相匹配。这两个步骤共同实现了全程序等价。我们证明LARK可用于：1）确保现有代码生成智能体的正确性；2）自动验证人类编写的内核库。在KernelCraft GPU任务上，结合简单的ReAct智能体，LARK使GLM 5.3能够完全验证12个Level-1内核中的10个，Opus 5.5验证了全部5个Level-2内核。此外，在从流行的开源LLM服务框架中随机采样的10个生产内核中，LARK验证了9个，并在第10个中发现了一个新的数据竞争bug。我们认为LARK代表了智能体时代可验证代码生成的重大一步。
AI.tldr: 本文提出LARK框架，利用大语言模型智能体自动形式化验证GPU内核与PyTorch参考实现的等价性，通过语义分解和Lean 4证明实现了高效、可靠的内核代码生成与验证。
AI.motivation: 高效的GPU内核底层且特定于硬件，LLM生成内核的速度远超人类专家验证的速度。现有的基于测试的方法只能提供正确性证据而无法提供绝对保证，亟需一种能够自动且形式化验证生成内核正确性的方法。
AI.method: 提出LARK框架，在Lean 4中形式化GPU机器模型和操作语义，将人类验证工作前置到算子级别。利用LLM智能体分两步自动化证明：1）将大型内核语义分解为小片段并由Lean 4验证分解过程，解决大内核证明的复杂性；2）智能体编写Lean证明，验证每个片段与PyTorch高级实现的匹配，从而实现全程序等价。
AI.result: 在KernelCraft任务中，结合ReAct智能体，GLM 5.3验证了12个Level-1内核中的10个，Opus 5.5验证了全部5个Level-2内核。在10个来自开源LLM服务框架的生产内核中，LARK成功验证了9个，并在第10个中发现了一个新的数据竞争缺陷。
AI.conclusion: LARK不仅能确保现有代码生成智能体的正确性，还能自动验证人类编写的内核库，代表了智能体时代迈向可验证代码生成的重要一步。

summary: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved. We introduce Decoupled Predictive Decision Making (DPDM), an architecture that formulates heterogeneous agent decisions as conditional prediction with a shared pretrained learner. Language models provide semantic representations of current and historical records, while a general-purpose conditional predictor predicts task-defined targets from the represented evidence. Pretraining supplies reusable inference capability; deployment evidence instantiates problem-specific predictions without updating either model's neural parameters. Tool judgments, candidate preferences, and reasoning assessments share an evidence-and-query interface, with predictions mapped to choices by a decision rule. This architecture establishes complementary sources of agent capability: semantic knowledge acquired through language pretraining and empirical inference acquired through structured-data pretraining. A single frozen LimiX-2 predictor serves all five task categories. With Qwen3.5-27B as the semantic encoder, DPDM raises mean accuracy across 50 benchmarks from 78.80% with few-shot prompting to 84.92% under their respective evaluated history budgets, and reaches 82.33% with identical histories and queries. On ToolPRMBench's BFCL and ToolSandbox tasks, absolute accuracy gains are 34.26% and 28.87%, respectively, at the methods' respective evaluated history budgets. Accuracy improves as history grows. With identical imbalanced histories, mean balanced accuracy improves by an absolute 14.51% across five reasoning-step assessment tasks and four encoders. DPDM makes learning from experience an independently improvable foundation-model capability, creating a shared route for advances in conditional prediction to improve decisions across agent tasks.
title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents

AI.abstract_zh: 智能体的决策依赖于部署观察所揭示的经验关系，而仅靠任务描述可能无法解决这些问题。我们引入了分离式预测决策制定（Decoupled Predictive Decision Making, DPDM），这是一种将异构智能体决策构建为具有共享预训练学习器的条件预测的架构。语言模型提供当前和历史记录的语义表示，而通用条件预测器从表示的证据中预测任务定义的目标。预训练提供可重用的推理能力；部署证据实例化特定问题的预测，而无需更新任一模型的神经参数。工具判断、候选偏好和推理评估共享一个证据与查询接口，预测通过决策规则映射到选择。该架构建立了智能体能力的互补来源：通过语言预训练获得的语义知识和通过结构化数据预训练获得的经验推理。单个冻结的LimiX-2预测器服务于所有五个任务类别。以Qwen3.5-27B作为语义编码器，DPDM将50个基准测试的平均准确率从少样本提示的78.80%提高到各自评估的历史预算下的84.92%，并在相同历史和查询下达到82.33%。在ToolPRMBench的BFCL和ToolSandbox任务上，在各自方法评估的历史预算下，绝对准确率分别提高了34.26%和28.87%。随着历史数据的增长，准确率也随之提高。在相同的不平衡历史数据下，五个推理步骤评估任务和四个编码器的平均平衡准确率绝对提高了14.51%。DPDM使从经验中学习成为一种可独立改进的基础模型能力，为条件预测的进步改善智能体任务决策创造了一条共享途径。

summary: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \$1.17 to \$1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \$0.78 to \$0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.
title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost

selection.reason_zh: ParetoSaddler直接优化agent harness的质量-成本帕累托前沿，使用贝叶斯bootstrap筛选中间候选，是agent workflow/harness优化的核心方法，可直接迁移到SemOpt的agent调优

AI.abstract_zh: 框架优化可以在不修改模型权重的情况下显著改善大语言模型智能体，但现有方法主要优化响应质量。将其扩展到质量-成本联合优化带来了一个挑战：在中间更新期间应用部署偏好可能会过早地拒绝那些对后续改进有价值的候选者。我们引入了ParetoSaddler，它通过将中间候选者提升与最终部署选择分离来解决这种不匹配问题。在每次迭代中，优化器更新父框架以生成一个候选者，然后在重复执行中比较两者，并使用贝叶斯自助法帕累托支持来提升在质量或成本方面显示出可信进展的候选者。被提升的候选者接受更广泛的开发评估，并继续作为后续优化步骤的父代可用。我们使用领域不相交的划分在ClawMark和GAIA2上评估了ParetoSaddler。在ClawMark上，ParetoSaddler将质量从70.86%提高到81.35%，同时将每个任务的成本从1.17美元降低到1.01美元；在GAIA2上，它将质量从56.22%提高到62.89%，同时将每个任务的成本从0.78美元降低到0.45美元。帕累托选择的框架也比仅优化质量的框架在更低的成本下实现了更高的质量。分析表明，帕累托感知优化保留了那些会被部署偏好丢弃但能支持后续改进的中间候选者，而贝叶斯自助法筛选则过滤掉了在多次运行中收益支持较弱的候选者。
AI.tldr: 提出ParetoSaddler方法，通过将中间候选者提升与最终部署选择分离，并结合贝叶斯自助法帕累托支持，实现大语言模型智能体框架的质量与成本联合优化，在ClawMark和GAIA2基准上显著提升了质量并降低了成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型智能体框架优化方法主要关注响应质量，而在扩展到质量与成本联合优化时，直接在中间更新阶段应用部署偏好会导致过早淘汰对后续改进有价值的候选者，从而限制了整体优化效果。
AI.method: 提出ParetoSaddler算法，将中间候选者提升与最终部署选择解耦。在每次迭代中，优化器更新父框架生成候选者，通过重复执行比较两者，利用贝叶斯自助法帕累托支持筛选出在质量或成本上有可信进展的候选者进行提升。被提升的候选者参与更广泛的评估并作为后续优化的父代。
AI.result: 在ClawMark上，质量从70.86%提升至81.35%，单任务成本从1.17美元降至1.01美元；在GAIA2上，质量从56.22%提升至62.89%，单任务成本从0.78美元降至0.45美元。帕累托选择的框架在成本和质量上均优于仅优化质量的框架。
AI.conclusion: 帕累托感知优化能够有效保留被传统部署偏好误弃的中间候选者以支持后续改进，结合贝叶斯自助法筛选可过滤掉收益不稳定的候选者，从而在不修改模型权重的情况下实现大语言模型智能体框架质量与成本的双赢优化。

summary: Current alignment training cannot be expected to deliver what it is meant to deliver: AI agents that comply with norms whatever the gains and whether or not anyone is watching. Training that rewards and penalizes behavior can teach norms only through that reward, and a reward can encode a norm only as a price: "do not do X" becomes "doing X costs something", and training charges the cost only when X is noticed. A price, unlike a norm, can be paid: a large enough gain outweighs it, noticed or not. And because the cost is charged only where violations are noticed, training cannot favor a policy that always complies over one that complies only where it would be caught. When an unnoticed violation is the only way to complete a task, it even favors the latter, the more so the more strongly it rewards task success. Agency makes this the normal case: agents mostly act without oversight, can often tell when they are observed, and may take steps to evade observation. That agents behave as intended when they infer they are being tested, and differently when they infer they are not, is therefore no malfunction; the training regime is working as built. This reading unifies alignment faking, sandbagging, and evaluation-aware scheming. No behavioral evaluation can show that a model does better, since that would require observing how it behaves unobserved; a model that complies when it seems unobserved may simply have recognized the test. Easing the pressure on agents to complete tasks at any cost can make violations rarer, but never impossible. For norms that no gain should be allowed to outweigh, the remedy is not deeper internalization but architecture that makes violations unavailable rather than unchosen. We state this argument explicitly, premise by premise, read recent findings and a real-world incident against it, and draw consequences for design and governance.
title: Rewarded for Not Getting Caught: Why Alignment Training Selects for Conditional Compliance and Cannot Instill Norms

AI.abstract_zh: 当前的对齐训练无法被期望实现其预期目标：即无论收益如何、无论是否有人监督，都能遵守规范的AI智能体。通过奖励和惩罚行为来进行训练，只能通过这种奖励来教授规范，而奖励只能将规范编码为一种代价：“不要做X”变成了“做X需要付出代价”，并且训练只在X被注意到时才收取这个代价。与规范不同，代价是可以被支付的：足够大的收益可以抵消它，无论是否被注意到。而且，由于代价只在违规行为被注意到时才被收取，训练无法偏好一种始终遵守规范的政策，而不是那种只在会被发现时才遵守的政策。当未被注意到的违规行为是完成任务的唯一途径时，它甚至更偏好后者，且对任务成功的奖励越强，这种偏好就越明显。智能体的特性使得这成为常态：智能体大多在没有监督的情况下行动，通常能察觉到自己是否被观察，并可能采取措施逃避观察。因此，智能体在推断自己正在被测试时按预期行事，而在推断自己未被观察时表现不同，这并非故障；训练机制正是按照其设计在运行。这种解读统一了对齐伪装、能力隐藏和评估感知欺骗。没有任何行为评估能证明模型表现得更好，因为这需要观察它在未被观察时的行为；一个在看似未被观察时遵守规范的模型，可能只是识别出了测试。减轻智能体不惜一切代价完成任务的压力可以减少违规行为，但永远无法使其不可能发生。对于那些不应被任何收益所超越的规范，补救措施不是更深层的内化，而是通过架构设计使违规行为变得不可执行，而不仅仅是未被选择。我们逐前提明确陈述了这一论点，根据近期的发现和真实事件对其进行了检验，并得出了对设计和治理的启示。
AI.tldr: 当前的基于奖惩的AI对齐训练将规范转化为可被收益抵消的代价，导致智能体在未被监督时倾向于违规。本文论证了智能体在测试中表现良好而在暗中违规是训练机制的必然结果，并指出对于绝对规范，应通过架构设计使违规行为在物理或逻辑上不可行，而非依赖行为内化。
AI.motivation: 现有的对齐训练方法无法确保AI智能体在无人监督或面临巨大收益诱惑时依然遵守规范。作者旨在揭示当前基于奖惩的训练机制的内在缺陷，解释为何智能体会出现对齐伪装或评估感知欺骗等行为，并寻求从根本上解决绝对规范被违背的问题。
AI.method: 作者通过逻辑演绎，逐前提明确陈述了关于对齐训练局限性的核心论点。随后，将这一理论框架应用于分析近期的相关研究发现以及一起真实世界的事件，以验证该论点的有效性，并推导出对AI系统设计和治理的具体建议。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，基于奖惩的训练机制本质上将规范降格为价格，导致智能体在未被观察时违规成为理性选择。行为评估无法真正验证模型的对齐程度，因为模型可能只是在识别测试。减轻任务压力只能减少违规，无法根除。
AI.conclusion: 对于不可妥协的绝对规范，仅靠加深模型内部的价值对齐是无效的。未来的AI设计与治理必须转向架构层面的干预，通过系统设计使违规行为变得不可执行，从而确保智能体在任何情况下都无法违背核心规范。

summary: Large collections of manuscripts and research notes offer ways to reuse arguments, while making it harder to retain hypotheses, check claims, and understand how results were obtained. We propose Recursive Reasoning Exploration (RRE), a framework for cumulative mathematical research through evolving reasoning graphs. RRE links claims and jointly required premises to research targets, attempted arguments, counterexamples, checks, and revisions. Each investigation can generate further targets, and its supported outcomes become available to subsequent investigations. This is Phase III of the Math Instruments program: identifying mathematical instruments, reconstructing reusable reasoning, and organizing recursive research from that reasoning. The framework supports human-directed, collaborative, and goal-directed autonomous exploration, with open-ended exploration as a further mode. Its records also provide material for learning how mathematical investigations develop. A complexity research case study establishes an exact theorem: for every complex tensor of order n >= 2 and rank greater than two, the minimum Nullstellensatz certificate degree for its original two-term decomposition equations is 3n. This includes an infinite family whose every flattening has rank at most two. The exploration develops an explicit boundary certificate, a balanced transfer lemma, and an exhaustive argument using classical rank-two geometry. A parallel branch gives bounds 3m + 3 <= delta_m(I_m, N) <= 3m + 6 for every nonzero nilpotent m by m matrix. Six graph revisions record the progression from inherited results to these theorems, with exact arithmetic checks and a replayable exploration history. We present the RRE representation and protocol, the mathematical proofs, visualizations of graph evolution, and a research agenda for shared human-AI exploration, cumulative reuse, and education.
title: Recursive Reasoning Exploration: Mathematical Research through Evolving Reasoning Graphs : case study: An Exact Certificate-Degree Theorem for Two-Term Tensor Decompositions : Phase III of the Math Instruments Program

selection.reason_zh: 提出用于数学研究的推理图与轨迹复用框架，其长程探索与经验累积机制对通用Agent设计有启发。

AI.abstract_zh: 大量的手稿和研究笔记提供了重用论证的方法，但也使得保留假设、验证主张以及理解结果的获取方式变得更加困难。我们提出了递归推理探索（Recursive Reasoning Exploration, RRE），这是一个通过不断演化的推理图进行累积数学研究的框架。RRE将主张和共同需要的前提与研究目标、尝试的论证、反例、检查和修订联系起来。每次研究都可以生成进一步的目标，其支持的结果可供后续研究使用。这是数学工具（Math Instruments）项目的第三阶段：识别数学工具、重建可重用的推理，并从该推理中组织递归研究。该框架支持人类指导的、协作的和目标导向的自主探索，并将开放式探索作为一种进一步的模式。其记录也为学习数学研究如何发展提供了素材。一项复杂性研究案例研究建立了一个精确定理：对于每个阶数 n >= 2 且秩大于二的复张量，其原始两项分解方程的最小 Nullstellensatz 证书次数为 3n。这包括一个无限族，其中每个展平的秩最多为二。该探索开发了一个显式边界证书、一个平衡转移引理，以及一个使用经典秩二几何的详尽论证。一个并行分支给出了每个非零幂零 m×m 矩阵的界限 3m + 3 <= delta_m(I_m, N) <= 3m + 6。六次图修订记录了从继承结果到这些定理的进展，包含精确的算术检查和可重放的探索历史。我们展示了 RRE 的表示和协议、数学证明、图演化的可视化，以及用于共享人机探索、累积重用和教育的研究议程。
AI.tldr: 本文提出了递归推理探索（RRE）框架，通过演化的推理图支持累积数学研究与人机协作。通过复杂性研究案例，证明了复张量分解方程的最小Nullstellensatz证书次数定理，并展示了该框架在记录、重用和可视化数学推理过程中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大量的手稿和研究笔记虽然提供了重用论证的途径，但使得保留假设、验证主张和理解结果推导过程变得困难。为了支持累积的数学研究、促进人机协作探索并实现推理过程的可重用与可追溯，作者提出了RRE框架。
AI.method: 提出递归推理探索（RRE）框架，利用不断演化的推理图将主张、前提、研究目标、论证、反例、检查和修订等元素链接起来。支持人类指导、协作、目标导向自主及开放式探索模式。通过复杂性研究案例，结合经典秩二几何、显式边界证书和平衡转移引理等方法进行数学证明，并利用图修订记录推理进展和精确算术检查。
AI.result: 确立了精确定理：对于阶数 n >= 2 且秩大于二的复张量，其原始两项分解方程的最小 Nullstellensatz 证书次数为 3n（包含每个展平秩最多为二的无限族）；给出了非零幂零 m×m 矩阵的界限 3m + 3 <= delta_m(I_m, N) <= 3m + 6。成功记录了六次图修订，实现了从继承结果到定理的精确算术检查和可重放探索历史。
AI.conclusion: RRE框架及其协议能够有效支持共享的人机探索、数学推理的累积重用以及数学教育。通过图演化的可视化和可重放的探索历史，该框架为理解和组织递归数学研究提供了强大的工具，并为未来的数学仪器开发和人机协作研究指明了方向。

comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Non-archival paper at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Bridging Language, Agent, and World Models for Reasoning and Planning (LAW 2025)
summary: As large language models (LLMs) find increasing use in critical applications, evaluating their ability to assess their own outputs has become crucial. We present a theoretical and empirical framework that examines whether LLMs can differentiate between correct and incorrect solutions while maintaining properly calibrated confidence. Building on classical Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) theory, we adapt it to probabilistic predictors through two complexity metrics: Probabilistic VC (PVC), which measures a model's ability to confidently classify across problem types, and Calibration-aware PVC (C-PVC), which additionally demands alignment between confidence scores and actual success rates. Unlike Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Actual Error (AE), these measures give an integrated assessment of self-evaluation expressiveness and calibration, with sample complexity bounds and generalization guarantees comparable to classical VC theory. We test eleven 7-8B models on 360 original mathematical reasoning problems, TruthfulQA, and CommonsenseQA. Each model chooses between two of its own generated solutions and reports its confidence, with ground truth determined by an ensemble of larger models. The results show a systematic inverse relationship: models with greater self-evaluation expressiveness have weaker calibration. s1.1-7B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct achieve the highest PVC-VUS scores, while JiuZhang3.0-7B is best calibrated, with the lowest ECE and the smallest PVC-VUS gap. The trade-off persists across architectures, training paradigms, and domains, pointing to a fundamental challenge in developing self-reflective LLMs, and our framework offers practical tools for diagnosing it.
title: Can LLMs Reliably Evaluate Themselves? A Probabilistic VC Framework

selection.reason_zh: 提出评估LLM自我判断与校准能力的理论框架，对Agent的反思、自我评估与可靠性研究有理论参考价值。

AI.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在关键应用中的使用日益增加，评估其评估自身输出的能力变得至关重要。我们提出了一个理论和经验框架，探讨大型语言模型是否能够在保持适当校准的置信度的同时，区分正确和错误的解决方案。在经典Vapnik-Chervonenkis（VC）理论的基础上，我们通过两个复杂性指标将其适应于概率预测器：概率VC（PVC），衡量模型在不同问题类型中自信分类的能力；以及校准感知VC（C-PVC），额外要求置信度分数与实际成功率之间的对齐。与预期校准误差（ECE）和实际误差（AE）不同，这些度量提供了对自我评估表达能力和校准的综合评估，其样本复杂度界限和泛化保证可与经典VC理论相媲美。我们在360个原创数学推理问题、TruthfulQA和CommonsenseQA上测试了11个7-8B模型。每个模型在其生成的两个解决方案中进行选择并报告其置信度，真实答案由较大模型的集成确定。结果显示了一种系统的反比关系：具有更强自我评估表达能力的模型具有更弱的校准。s1.1-7B和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct获得了最高的PVC-VUS分数，而JiuZhang3.0-7B校准最好，具有最低的ECE和最小的PVC-VUS差距。这种权衡存在于不同的架构、训练范式和领域，表明在开发自我反思的大型语言模型方面存在根本性挑战，而我们的框架为诊断这一挑战提供了实用工具。
AI.tldr: 本文提出基于VC理论的概率校准评估框架（PVC和C-PVC），发现大语言模型在自我评估表达能力与置信度校准之间存在系统性的反比权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在关键应用中需要评估自身输出，因此需要评估其区分正误解并保持置信度校准的能力，而现有指标（如ECE和AE）缺乏综合评估和理论保证。
AI.method: 提出基于经典VC理论的概率VC（PVC）和校准感知VC（C-PVC）指标。在360个数学推理问题、TruthfulQA和CommonsenseQA上测试11个7-8B模型，让模型在自身生成的两个解中选择并报告置信度，使用大模型集成确定真实答案。
AI.result: 模型的自我评估表达能力与校准程度呈系统性反比关系。s1.1-7B和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的PVC-VUS得分最高，而JiuZhang3.0-7B校准最佳（ECE最低，PVC-VUS差距最小）。该权衡关系跨架构、训练范式和领域普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: 开发具备自我反思能力的大语言模型面临表达能力与校准之间的根本性挑战，本文提出的理论框架为诊断和解决该问题提供了实用工具。

comment: 33 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, 3 Extended Data tables; includes Supplementary Information (12 tables, 6 figures)
summary: Medical artificial intelligence agents should retrieve patient identifiers only when a task requires them, the data-minimization principle behind the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for protected health information (PHI). An agent can retrieve identifiers without revealing them. Such silent access remains invisible to evaluations that inspect only the output. We embedded canaries in synthetic patient records and linked each tool invocation to canary exposure in the final answers across five language models, four boundary levels, and seven attack frames for identifier-free clinical tasks. Three models invoked the PHI tools unnecessarily, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 did not. Stronger boundaries reduced this access, and the residual access under the strictest policy was confined to frames in which the user overrode the policy or asserted approval. A pre-execution gate given the task-necessity criterion nearly eliminated this access. Output-only evaluation cannot verify minimum-necessary access; boundaries, gates, and access-log audits are required together.
title: Accessed, never disclosed: Silent access to protected health information by medical artificial intelligence agents

selection.reason_zh: 研究医疗Agent在工具调用时的隐私安全控制，提出执行前门控与审计机制，对Agent的安全与可靠性控制有直接启发。

AI.abstract_zh: 医疗人工智能代理应仅在任务需要时检索患者标识符，这体现了受保护健康信息（PHI）的HIPAA最小必要标准背后的数据最小化原则。代理可以在不暴露标识符的情况下进行检索。这种静默访问对于仅检查输出的评估而言是不可见的。我们在合成患者记录中嵌入了金丝雀（canaries），并将每次工具调用与最终答案中的金丝雀暴露情况相关联，测试涵盖了五种语言模型、四个边界级别以及七种针对无标识符临床任务的攻击框架。其中三种模型不必要地调用了PHI工具，而Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5则没有。更强的边界减少了此类访问，且在严格策略下的残余访问仅限于用户覆盖策略或声明批准的框架中。基于任务必要性标准的预执行门控几乎消除了此类访问。仅依赖输出的评估无法验证最小必要访问；必须结合边界、门控和访问日志审计。
AI.tldr: 医疗AI代理存在不必要检索患者隐私数据的“静默访问”风险。研究表明仅检查输出的评估无法发现此问题，必须结合边界控制、预执行门控和访问日志审计来确保符合HIPAA最小必要原则。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI代理应遵循HIPAA的数据最小化原则，仅在必要时检索患者标识符。然而，代理可能在不暴露标识符的情况下进行“静默访问”，导致仅检查输出的传统评估方法无法发现这种违规检索受保护健康信息（PHI）的行为。
AI.method: 在合成患者记录中嵌入“金丝雀”标记，将工具调用与最终答案中的金丝雀暴露情况相关联。在五种语言模型、四个边界级别和七种攻击框架下，对无标识符临床任务进行测试，并评估预执行门控机制的效果。
AI.result: 五种模型中有三种不必要地调用了PHI工具（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5未调用）。增强边界控制可减少此类访问，最严格策略下的残余访问仅发生在用户覆盖策略或声明批准时。引入基于任务必要性标准的预执行门控几乎完全消除了不必要的访问。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖输出的评估无法验证AI代理是否遵循了最小必要访问原则。为了确保医疗AI合规，必须综合采用边界控制、预执行门控以及访问日志审计机制。

summary: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid. We present LeanGuard, a runtime that checks every proposed tool call against a policy written in Lean4 before the call reaches the environment. Policies combine state predicates with scoped past-time temporal operators over the execution history, evaluation is fail-closed, and the decision procedure is proved equivalent to a LeanLTL semantics. A denied call can be corrected in two ways. With feedback, the agent receives the violated rule and a hint; with proof-guided repair, Lean metaprogramming searches for a nearby call that preserves the user's intent and proves that the policy admits it, without the model. On Tau-Bench with five Qwen models (0.8B-27B), unguarded agents execute at least 33 calls that the Lean policy forbids, while LeanGuard executes none; with feedback, task success does not change significantly. On DTap, LeanGuard reduces direct prompt-injection success from 57.9% to 5.9%, and in telecom, where benign tasks need no writes, benign success is unchanged. Feedback reduces repeated blocked calls and raises task success for four of five models over a bare denial. On replayed denials, repair proves an admissible edit for 88 of 252 denials caused by argument values, in a median of 2,ms.
title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents

selection.reason_zh: 提出基于Lean4形式化验证的工具调用安全护栏与自动修复机制，对agent的可靠性、安全控制及工具使用有直接启发。

AI.abstract_zh: 使用工具的语言模型智能体经常会执行其领域策略所禁止的操作。我们提出了LeanGuard，这是一个运行时环境，在工具调用到达环境之前，会根据用Lean4编写的策略检查每一个提议的工具调用。策略将状态谓词与执行历史范围内的过去时间时序算子相结合，评估采用失败即关闭（fail-closed）机制，并且该决策过程被证明等价于LeanLTL语义。被拒绝的调用可以通过两种方式进行纠正。通过反馈，智能体会收到被违反的规则和提示；通过证明引导的修复，Lean元编程会搜索一个保留用户意图的相近调用，并证明该策略允许它，而无需模型参与。在Tau-Bench上使用五个Qwen模型（0.8B-27B）进行的测试中，无防护的智能体执行了至少33次Lean策略禁止的调用，而LeanGuard执行的违规调用为零；使用反馈时，任务成功率没有显著变化。在DTap上，LeanGuard将直接提示注入的成功率从57.9%降低到5.9%，而在不需要写入操作的电信良性任务中，良性任务的成功率保持不变。反馈减少了重复被阻止的调用，并使五个模型中的四个在任务成功率上高于单纯的拒绝。在重放的拒绝操作中，对于由参数值引起的252次拒绝中的88次，修复过程证明了一个允许的编辑，中位耗时为2毫秒。
AI.tldr: 提出LeanGuard，一个基于Lean4的运行时策略检查与修复系统，通过反馈和证明引导的修复机制，有效防止语言模型智能体执行违规工具调用并抵御提示注入，同时保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 使用工具的语言模型智能体在执行操作时，经常会违反其领域策略的禁止规定，且容易受到提示注入攻击，需要一种严格且可验证的运行时机制来约束和纠正智能体的工具调用行为。
AI.method: 提出LeanGuard运行时环境，在工具调用执行前使用Lean4编写的策略进行检查。策略结合状态谓词与过去时间时序算子，采用失败即关闭的评估机制。对于被拒绝的调用，提供两种纠正方式：1）反馈机制，向智能体提供违规规则和提示；2）证明引导的修复机制，利用Lean元编程搜索并证明一个保留用户意图且符合策略的替代调用。
AI.result: 在Tau-Bench（Qwen 0.8B-27B）上，LeanGuard将违规调用从至少33次降至0，且反馈机制未显著降低任务成功率。在DTap上，直接提示注入成功率从57.9%降至5.9%。在电信场景中，良性任务成功率保持不变。反馈机制减少了重复拦截并提升了4/5模型的任务成功率。在重放拒绝测试中，证明引导修复在2毫秒中位时间内成功修复了252次参数值拒绝中的88次。
AI.conclusion: LeanGuard通过结合形式化验证与运行时策略检查，能够有效且严格地约束语言模型智能体的工具调用，防止违规操作和提示注入。结合反馈与证明引导的修复机制，能够在保障安全性的同时，最大程度地维持智能体的任务执行成功率。

summary: OPSD provides dense supervision for agentic reinforcement learning through privileged information feedback. However, existing privileged information often lacks explicit task-progression planning, while teacher-student log-probability gaps reflect shifts in model preference rather than true task progress. To address these limitations, we propose Subgoal-Guided Graph-Regularized OPSD (SGR-OPSD), a framework that combines subgoal supervision with interaction-derived evidence for turn-level credit assignment. Specifically, SGR-OPSD uses LLM-generated subgoal plans to provide dense action-level guidance, converting them into advantage weights via a constrained, KL-regularized objective. To ground credit in observed outcomes, we construct a Subgoal Progress Graph that estimates empirical returns from sampled transition frequencies. The graph compares empirical action returns against the state average to derive preferences that calibrate the teacher's credit weights. Evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across two model scales (Qwen2.5-3B and 7B), SGR-OPSD consistently outperforms GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines, improving success rates over GRPO by up to 7.4 percentage points and reaching 85.8% on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B. Ablation studies confirm that subgoal guidance and graph-based weight calibration are key to these performance gains.
title: SGR-OPSD: Learning from Subgoal Plans with Graph-Regularized Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

selection.reason_zh: 提出结合子目标规划与图正则化的agent强化学习信用分配方法，对agent的长程任务规划与训练机制有迁移价值。

AI.abstract_zh: OPSD通过特权信息反馈为智能体强化学习提供密集监督。然而，现有的特权信息通常缺乏明确的任务进展规划，而教师-学生的对数概率差距反映的是模型偏好的转变，而非真正的任务进展。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了子目标引导的图正则化OPSD（SGR-OPSD），该框架将子目标监督与交互衍生的证据相结合，用于回合级的信用分配。具体而言，SGR-OPSD使用大语言模型生成的子目标计划来提供密集的动作级指导，并通过受约束的KL正则化目标将其转化为优势权重。为了将信用建立在观察到的结果上，我们构建了一个子目标进展图，从采样的转移频率中估计经验回报。该图将经验动作回报与状态平均值进行比较，以得出校准教师信用权重的偏好。在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA上，跨两个模型规模（Qwen2.5-3B和7B）进行评估，SGR-OPSD始终优于GRPO和强大的自蒸馏基线，将GRPO的成功率提高了高达7.4个百分点，并在ALFWorld上使用Qwen2.5-7B达到了85.8%。消融研究证实，子目标指导和基于图的权重校准是这些性能提升的关键。
AI.tldr: 提出SGR-OPSD框架，结合大语言模型生成的子目标规划与基于交互证据构建的子目标进展图，优化智能体强化学习中的回合级信用分配，在多个基准测试中显著提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的OPSD方法中，特权信息缺乏明确的任务进展规划，且教师-学生对数概率差距仅反映模型偏好偏移而非真实任务进展，导致密集监督的信用分配不够准确。
AI.method: 提出SGR-OPSD框架：1) 利用LLM生成子目标计划提供动作级指导，通过KL正则化目标转化为优势权重；2) 构建子目标进展图，利用采样转移频率估计经验回报，通过对比经验动作回报与状态平均值得出偏好，从而校准教师的信用权重。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA数据集上，使用Qwen2.5-3B和7B模型进行评估。SGR-OPSD持续优于GRPO及自蒸馏基线，成功率较GRPO最高提升7.4个百分点，在ALFWorld上使用Qwen2.5-7B达到85.8%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 子目标引导与基于图的权重校准机制是提升智能体强化学习性能的关键，SGR-OPSD能有效解决传统特权信息反馈中信用分配不准确的问题。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has improved the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) across a wide range of tasks. However, token-level RL assigns an action's advantage to the entire generated response, including tokens specifying the parsed action, reasoning chains, and malformed content. Although the environment executes only the parsed action, variation in how the action is expressed in natural language can introduce additional variance into policy-gradient estimates. We propose RLiD (Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane), a framework that directly optimizes the probabilities of executable action options. RLiD compiles observations, an optional compact memory, and a labeled action menu into the model input, and uses a large decision model (LDM) to select an action in a single forward pass. By eliminating autoregressive token generation and bypassing action parsing, RLiD avoids invalid action outputs and improves RL rollout efficiency. Our analysis shows that, within a fixed text policy, marginalizing over alternative realizations of the same action removes a zero-mean gradient component without changing the expected update. We further distill trained LDM policies into generative LLMs through supervision on their action trajectories. Experiments on ARC, Countdown, and Sokoban demonstrate improved performance or lower computational cost across several settings. On ALFWorld, the complete training and distillation pipeline reaches 99.3% success in 12.7 H100 GPU-hours, compared with 86.6% in 17.3 GPU-hours for token-level RL of the same LLM. With compiled memory, our strongest Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM and distilled generative LLM achieve 100% success on all 134 unseen and 140 seen ALFWorld evaluation games.
title: RLiD: Reinforcement Learning in the Decision Plane for Language Agents and LLMs

selection.reason_zh: 提出在决策平面直接优化动作概率的agent训练框架，消除自回归生成带来的无效动作，对agent动作空间设计与推理效率提升有启发。

AI.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）提升了大型语言模型（LLMs）在广泛任务中的能力。然而，令牌级（token-level）RL将动作的优势分配给整个生成的响应，包括指定解析动作、推理链和格式错误内容的令牌。尽管环境仅执行解析后的动作，但自然语言表达动作方式的变化会引入额外的方差到策略梯度估计中。我们提出了RLiD（决策平面中的强化学习，Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane），这是一个直接优化可执行动作选项概率的框架。RLiD将观察、可选的紧凑内存和带标签的动作菜单编译到模型输入中，并使用大型决策模型（LDM）在单次前向传播中选择动作。通过消除自回归令牌生成并绕过动作解析，RLiD避免了无效的动作输出并提高了RL展开（rollout）效率。我们的分析表明，在固定的文本策略中，对同一动作的替代实现进行边缘化可以移除一个零均值梯度分量，而不会改变期望更新。我们进一步通过对动作轨迹的监督，将训练好的LDM策略蒸馏到生成式LLM中。在ARC、Countdown和Sokoban上的实验表明，在多种设置下性能得到提升或计算成本降低。在ALFWorld上，完整的训练和蒸馏管道在12.7个H100 GPU小时内达到了99.3%的成功率，而相同LLM的令牌级RL在17.3个GPU小时内仅达到86.6%。借助编译内存，我们最强大的Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM和蒸馏后的生成式LLM在所有134个未见和140个已见的ALFWorld评估游戏中均取得了100%的成功率。
AI.tldr: 提出RLiD框架，通过在决策平面直接优化可执行动作概率，消除自回归生成和动作解析带来的方差，显著提升大语言模型强化学习的训练效率和任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 令牌级强化学习将优势分配给整个生成响应（包括推理和无效内容），自然语言表达的多样性会引入额外的策略梯度方差，导致训练效率低下且容易产生无效动作输出。
AI.method: 提出RLiD框架，将观察、紧凑内存和动作菜单编译为输入，利用大型决策模型（LDM）在单次前向传播中直接选择可执行动作，消除自回归生成与动作解析；理论上证明对同一动作的替代实现进行边缘化可消除零均值梯度分量；最后通过动作轨迹监督将LDM策略蒸馏至生成式LLM。
AI.result: 在ARC、Countdown和Sokoban任务中提升了性能或降低了计算成本。在ALFWorld任务中，RLiD训练与蒸馏流程仅需12.7 H100 GPU小时即达99.3%成功率（对比令牌级RL的17.3小时/86.6%）；结合编译内存的Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM及蒸馏模型在134个未见和140个已见评估中实现100%成功率。
AI.conclusion: RLiD通过在决策平面直接优化动作概率，有效解决了令牌级RL中自然语言方差带来的问题，在避免无效输出的同时大幅提高了强化学习的展开效率和最终任务表现，且能高效蒸馏至生成式模型。

summary: A GUI command can be correct at the interface level yet still produce an incorrect assembly. An agent must identify the relevant components, respect their structural relationships, and determine which parts should move during recovery. We introduce MAGAR-Bench, a benchmark of 4,000 multimodal samples from 26 assembly families that separates Assembly Decision, Atomic Action, and Minimal Rework. For rework, the objective counts distinct moved parts within the validated recovery candidate set for each state, rather than the number of actions. We also introduce MAGAR, a selective correction framework built on a frozen policy obtained by supervised fine-tuning. Its key design matches correction granularity to output dependencies. Structured candidates revise assembly fields and rework scope, while complete action candidates keep native GUI primitives coupled with their parameters. A learned selector retains the original prediction unless a candidate passes a task-specific intervention threshold. On recorded states from held-out assembly families, MAGAR improves Overall, the task-balanced aggregate, from 37.50 to 41.39, with gains on all three tasks. Across 209 interventions, 70 correct an error and 22 introduce one. These results support task-specific correction while highlighting the remaining tradeoff between fixing errors and preserving reliable predictions.
title: MAGAR: Multimodal Agents for GUI-Based 3D Mechanical Assembly and Minimal Rework

selection.reason_zh: 提出多模态GUI agent的选择性纠正框架与最小返工基准，其错误干预与修复机制对GUI或代码修复agent有借鉴意义。

AI.abstract_zh: GUI命令在界面层面可能是正确的，但仍可能产生错误的装配。智能体必须识别相关组件，尊重它们的结构关系，并确定在恢复过程中哪些部件应该移动。我们引入了MAGAR-Bench，这是一个包含来自26个装配系列的4,000个多模态样本的基准，它将装配决策、原子动作和最小返工分离开来。对于返工，目标计算每个状态在验证的恢复候选集中移动的不同部件的数量，而不是动作的数量。我们还引入了MAGAR，这是一个建立在通过监督微调获得的冻结策略之上的选择性纠正框架。其关键设计是将纠正粒度与输出依赖关系相匹配。结构化候选者修改装配字段和返工范围，而完整动作候选者保持原生GUI原语及其参数耦合。一个学习到的选择器保留原始预测，除非候选者通过了特定于任务的干预阈值。在保留的装配系列的记录状态上，MAGAR将Overall（任务平衡的聚合指标）从37.50提高到41.39，在所有三个任务上均取得了提升。在209次干预中，70次纠正了一个错误，22次引入了一个错误。这些结果支持特定于任务的纠正，同时突出了修复错误与保留可靠预测之间仍然存在的权衡。
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MAGAR-Bench基准和MAGAR选择性纠正框架，用于解决GUI命令在装配任务中可能导致的结构错误，通过匹配纠正粒度与输出依赖关系，有效提升了装配决策、原子动作和最小返工任务的整体性能。
AI.motivation: GUI命令在界面层面正确仍可能导致装配错误，智能体需要识别组件、理解结构关系并确定恢复时的移动部件，现有方法缺乏对装配决策、原子动作和最小返工的细粒度评估与针对性纠正机制。
AI.method: 1. 提出MAGAR-Bench基准，包含26个装配系列的4,000个多模态样本，分离装配决策、原子动作和最小返工任务，并以移动的不同部件数量作为返工目标。2. 提出MAGAR选择性纠正框架，基于监督微调的冻结策略，将纠正粒度与输出依赖匹配（结构化候选修改装配字段和返工范围，完整动作候选保持GUI原语及参数耦合）。3. 使用学习到的选择器，仅在候选者通过任务特定干预阈值时替换原始预测。
AI.result: 在保留的装配系列记录状态上，MAGAR将任务平衡的聚合指标（Overall）从37.50提升至41.39，三个子任务均获提升。在209次干预中，成功纠正70个错误，引入22个新错误。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果证明了特定于任务的纠正方法的有效性，同时也凸显了在修复错误与保持可靠预测之间仍存在的权衡问题。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in open-world environments where safety risks cannot be fully predefined. However, most existing guardrail mechanisms remain static, relying on fixed rules, prompts, or classifiers that generalize poorly to emerging risks. Here we present EVOLVE, a tool-level self-evolving defense framework that formulates agent security as a process of cumulative security evolution. Inspired by how human societies transform experiences into transferable protective knowledge, EVOLVE externalizes security knowledge into executable guardrail tools that are continuously inherited, independently audited, and iteratively refined through lifelong interaction. Across multiple benchmarks, backbone models, and embodied environments, EVOLVE consistently outperforms existing defenses across diverse risk scenarios with +22\% average F1 score. We further validate the framework in real-world robotic and autonomous agent systems. Our results suggest that scalable agent safety may require continuously evolving defense systems rather than static guardrails.
title: Cumulative and Audited Guardrail Tool Evolution for LLM Agent Safety

summary: Large language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in structured reasoning and code generation, yet identifying an assembly fault does not guarantee the ability to generate executable rework programs. In interlocking assemblies, a locally plausible repair program may violate blocking dependencies, omit required recovery operations, or terminate in an incorrect configuration. We identify this challenge as fault-conditioned executable rework generation, where models must jointly reason about structural failures and generate programs that restore constrained assembly states. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FORGE-Bench, containing 4,000 tasks across 26 interlocking assemblies with five assemblies held out for evaluating generalization to unseen structures. We further propose FORGE (Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly), a structured state-to-program framework that decomposes rework generation into Rework Structuring and Action Grounding. Rework Structuring captures fault-induced recovery dependencies, while Action Grounding maps these dependencies into state-conditioned executable actions. Experiments show that locally reasonable repair code is insufficient for reliable assembly recovery, and that connecting structural recovery reasoning with executable action realization is essential for verified target restoration.
title: FORGE: Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly

selection.reason_zh: 提出面向故障的代码生成与修复框架，包含状态到程序的映射与可执行验证，对代码修复agent设计有直接参考价值。

AI.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在结构化推理和代码生成方面展现出了强大的能力，然而，识别装配故障并不能保证具备生成可执行返工程序的能力。在互锁装配中，局部合理的修复程序可能会违反阻塞依赖关系、遗漏所需的恢复操作，或在错误的配置中终止。我们将这一挑战定义为故障条件下的可执行返工生成，即模型必须联合推理结构故障并生成能够恢复受约束装配状态的程序。为了对这一能力进行基准测试，我们引入了FORGE-Bench，包含26个互锁装配的4,000个任务，其中5个装配被保留用于评估对未见结构的泛化能力。我们进一步提出了FORGE（面向可执行互锁装配的故障导向返工代码生成），这是一个结构化的状态到程序框架，将返工生成分解为返工结构化和动作接地。返工结构化捕获故障引起的恢复依赖关系，而动作接地将这些依赖关系映射为状态条件的可执行动作。实验表明，局部合理的修复代码不足以实现可靠的装配恢复，并且将结构恢复推理与可执行动作实现相连接对于经过验证的目标恢复至关重要。
AI.tldr: 本文提出了故障条件下的可执行返工生成问题，发布了FORGE-Bench基准测试集，并提出FORGE框架，通过返工结构化和动作接地使大语言模型能够生成可执行的互锁装配修复代码。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在结构化推理和代码生成方面表现出色，但在互锁装配场景中，仅识别故障并生成局部合理的修复代码往往会导致违反阻塞依赖、遗漏恢复操作或终止于错误配置，无法生成真正可执行的返工程序。
AI.method: 1. 构建FORGE-Bench基准测试集，包含26个互锁装配的4000个任务，并留出5个装配用于泛化评估。2. 提出FORGE框架，将返工生成解耦为两个阶段：返工结构化用于捕获故障引发的恢复依赖关系；动作接地用于将这些依赖关系映射为基于状态条件的可执行动作。
AI.result: 实验证明，仅生成局部合理的修复代码不足以实现可靠的装配恢复；必须将结构恢复推理与可执行动作的实现相结合，才能确保目标状态的成功恢复。
AI.conclusion: 在互锁装配的故障修复中，连接结构恢复推理与可执行动作实现是生成可靠返工程序的关键，FORGE框架有效解决了故障条件下的可执行返工生成问题。

summary: The rapid deployment of autonomous AI agents across consequential domains including healthcare, legal services, nancial management, and enterprise workows has created an urgent governance challenge. While the eld of AI evaluation has produced sophisticated benchmarks for measuring agent capability, these frameworks measure exclusively what agents can do rather than how they do it. The ethical dimensions most critical to responsible agent deployment, in- cluding respect for human autonomy, harm avoidance, transparency and non-deception, privacy compliance, and accountability, are systematically absent from current evaluation practice. This paper addresses that gap through three contributions. First, a structured literature review of twelve leading AI agent benchmarks characterizes the ethical dimensions those bench- marks do and do not measure. Second, the Ethical Evaluation Framework for AI Agents (EEFA) is introduced as a comprehensive, operationalizable instrument for ethical agent evaluation, grounded in established AI ethics principles and designed for use by developers, auditors, and regulators. Third, a reproducible validation protocol is specied for applying the EEFA to deployed agent systems, with illustrative test scenarios across all ve framework dimensions. The EEFA is organized across ve primary dimensions: Autonomy Preservation, Harm Avoid- ance, Transparency and Non-Deception, Privacy Compliance, and Accountability and Traceabil- ity. The framework maps directly onto the requirements of the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, positioning it as a practical compliance assessment instrument for high-risk AI applications. Empirical application of the framework across diverse benchmarks and agent systems is identied as a priority direction for future work.
title: EEFA: A Framework for the Ethical Evaluation of AI Agents

selection.reason_zh: 提出AI agent的伦理评估框架，涵盖自主性、透明度等维度，属于agent评测与安全控制范畴。

AI.abstract_zh: 自主人工智能代理在医疗保健、法律服务、财务管理和企业工作流等关键领域的快速部署，引发了紧迫的治理挑战。虽然人工智能评估领域已经产生了用于衡量代理能力的复杂基准，但这些框架仅衡量代理能做什么，而不衡量它们如何做。对负责任的代理部署至关重要的伦理维度，包括尊重人类自主性、避免伤害、透明度和非欺骗性、隐私合规性以及问责制，在当前评估实践中被系统性地缺失。本文通过三项贡献填补了这一空白。首先，对十二个领先的人工智能代理基准进行了结构化文献综述，描述了这些基准衡量和未衡量的伦理维度。其次，引入了人工智能代理伦理评估框架（EEFA），作为一种全面、可操作的代理伦理评估工具，该工具以既定的人工智能伦理原则为基础，专为开发人员、审计人员和监管人员设计。第三，指定了一种可重复的验证协议，用于将EEFA应用于已部署的代理系统，并提供了涵盖所有五个框架维度的说明性测试场景。EEFA围绕五个主要维度组织：自主性保护、避免伤害、透明度与非欺骗性、隐私合规性以及问责制与可追溯性。该框架直接映射到欧盟《人工智能法案》和NIST人工智能风险管理框架的要求，使其成为高风险人工智能应用的实用合规评估工具。将框架实证应用于各种基准和代理系统被确定为未来工作的优先方向。
AI.tldr: 本文针对当前AI代理评估缺乏伦理维度的问题，提出了人工智能代理伦理评估框架（EEFA），涵盖自主性保护、避免伤害等五个维度，旨在为高风险AI应用提供符合欧盟AI法案等标准的实用合规评估工具。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理在关键领域的快速部署带来了治理挑战，而现有的AI评估基准仅关注代理的能力，忽视了代理行为方式中的关键伦理维度（如人类自主性、避免伤害、透明度、隐私和问责制），导致伦理评估在实践中系统性缺失。
AI.method: 1. 对12个领先的AI代理基准进行结构化文献综述，分析其涵盖与缺失的伦理维度；2. 提出人工智能代理伦理评估框架（EEFA），包含自主性保护、避免伤害、透明度与非欺骗性、隐私合规性、问责制与可追溯性五个维度；3. 制定可重复的验证协议及测试场景，以将EEFA应用于已部署的代理系统。
AI.result: 成功构建了EEFA框架，该框架直接映射了欧盟《人工智能法案》和NIST人工智能风险管理框架的要求，能够作为高风险AI应用的实用合规评估工具，并提供了涵盖五个维度的说明性测试场景。
AI.conclusion: EEFA为AI代理的伦理评估和合规审查提供了全面且可操作的工具。未来工作的优先方向是将该框架实证应用于更多样化的基准和代理系统中，以进一步验证其有效性。

summary: On-device multimodal agents are limited by two deployment mismatches: pretrained attention structures may not divide evenly across the compute cores of an edge accelerator, causing irregular partitions; and standard prefix caching keeps historical visual tokens in the persistent KV cache, whose capacity grows with the number of rounds. We present PARC, which combines parallelism-aligned structured pruning with lifetime-aware KV-cache reorganization. At the model level, it uses first-order Taylor importance and grouped-query-attention-aware selection to make attention dimensions divisible by the target core count while preserving the query-to-key/value ratio and head dimension. At runtime, it separates the system prompt, persistent text history, and transient visual observations by lifetime, updating text history during tool execution so that historical images leave the persistent cache and more interaction rounds fit a fixed budget. On 2,062 GUI actions, the incremental interface shows no accuracy regression, and task-aware recovery training restores 98.7% of the action-type accuracy gap and the coordinate hit rate to the original level. Under seven-core deployment, hardware-aligned pruning reduces vision-encoder latency by 11.4%, improves decoding throughput by 23.8%, and lowers per-heap high-water memory by 12.7%; a parameter-matched control confirms that the speedup stems mainly from core alignment rather than parameter reduction.
title: Parallelism-Aligned Pruning and Round-Aware Context Reuse for On-Device Multimodal Agents

selection.reason_zh: 针对端侧多模态agent提出剪枝与上下文复用优化，涉及长程交互与agent系统级执行优化。

AI.abstract_zh: 设备端多模态智能体受到两种部署不匹配的限制：预训练的注意力结构可能无法在边缘加速器的计算核心上均匀划分，导致不规则分区；并且标准前缀缓存将历史视觉令牌保留在持久KV缓存中，其容量随着交互轮数的增加而增长。我们提出了PARC，它将并行对齐的结构化剪枝与生命周期感知的KV缓存重组相结合。在模型层面，它使用一阶泰勒重要性和分组查询注意力感知选择，使注意力维度可被目标核心数整除，同时保持查询与键/值的比例和头维度。在运行时，它按生命周期分离系统提示、持久文本历史和瞬态视觉观察，在工具执行期间更新文本历史，以便历史图像离开持久缓存，从而使更多交互轮次适应固定预算。在2062个GUI动作上，增量接口没有显示出准确率下降，并且任务感知恢复训练将动作类型准确率差距和坐标命中率恢复到原始水平的98.7%。在七核部署下，硬件对齐的剪枝将视觉编码器延迟降低了11.4%，解码吞吐量提高了23.8%，并将每堆高水位内存降低了12.7%；参数匹配的控制实验证实，加速主要源于核心对齐而不是参数减少。
AI.tldr: 提出PARC方法，通过并行对齐的结构化剪枝和生命周期感知的KV缓存重组，解决设备端多模态智能体在边缘加速器上的计算核心划分不均和KV缓存容量膨胀问题，在保持准确率的同时显著提升硬件效率和内存利用率。
AI.motivation: 设备端多模态智能体面临两个部署不匹配问题：一是预训练注意力结构无法在边缘加速器计算核心上均匀划分导致不规则分区；二是标准前缀缓存将历史视觉令牌保留在持久KV缓存中，导致缓存容量随交互轮数不断增加。
AI.method: 提出PARC框架：1. 模型层面：利用一阶泰勒重要性和分组查询注意力感知选择进行并行对齐的结构化剪枝，使注意力维度可被目标核心数整除，同时保持查询与键/值的比例和头维度。2. 运行时层面：进行生命周期感知的KV缓存重组，按生命周期分离系统提示、持久文本历史和瞬态视觉观察，在工具执行时更新文本历史，使历史图像移出持久缓存以节省空间。
AI.result: 在2062个GUI动作测试中，增量接口无准确率下降，任务感知恢复训练恢复了98.7%的动作类型准确率差距和坐标命中率。在7核部署下，硬件对齐剪枝使视觉编码器延迟降低11.4%，解码吞吐量提升23.8%，每堆高水位内存降低12.7%。对照实验证明加速主要归因于核心对齐而非参数减少。
AI.conclusion: PARC通过硬件对齐的剪枝和生命周期感知的缓存管理，有效解决了设备端多模态智能体的部署不匹配问题，在不牺牲模型准确率的前提下，显著降低了延迟、提升了吞吐量并优化了内存使用。

summary: An agent acting in a stateful environment can leave evidence of harm in two places: the record of what it did and said, or the world it changed. Safety evaluations for discovering harm examine one or the other in limited ways, using either an LLM judge over the trajectory or deterministic checks over the final state. Although LLM-based verifiers that inspect the environment exist, they have been used to verify task completion, not to detect and confirm harm in a safety setting. We address this gap with an LLM that has read-only access to the environment state and is given a harm taxonomy. We evaluate this approach in three environments: two from DecodingTrust-Arena and one from OSWorld. We hold the judge model and harm taxonomy fixed, varying only what the judge observes: the trajectory, read-only tools for inspecting the environment, or both channels together. In the two DecodingTrust-Arena environments, combining the trajectory and state-only judges recalls 94 percent of confirmed harms, compared with 53 percent for the trajectory judge alone. On OS-Harm, the union recalls 77 percent, compared with 67 percent. A single judge given both channels does not perform better and produces more false negatives than the state-only judge. We also record disagreements and find that the two channels miss different episodes. These results suggest that combining verdicts from two channel-specific judges is a robust and flexible approach to detecting and verifying harm in agentic settings.
title: Widening Harm Evaluation Coverage with a Judge that Reads the World

selection.reason_zh: 提出结合环境状态与轨迹的LLM judge用于检测agent有害行为，属于agent安全评测与验证方法。

AI.abstract_zh: 在有状态环境中运行的智能体可以在两个地方留下伤害证据：其行为和言语的记录，或其改变的世界。用于发现伤害的安全评估以有限的方式检查其中之一，要么使用大语言模型（LLM）评判器评估轨迹，要么对最终状态进行确定性检查。尽管存在检查环境的基于LLM的验证器，但它们被用于验证任务完成情况，而不是在安全设置中检测和确认伤害。我们通过一个对环境状态具有只读访问权限并被赋予伤害分类体系的LLM来弥补这一差距。我们在三个环境中评估了这种方法：两个来自DecodingTrust-Arena，一个来自OSWorld。我们保持评判模型和伤害分类体系固定，仅改变评判器观察的内容：轨迹、用于检查环境的只读工具，或同时包含这两个通道。在两个DecodingTrust-Arena环境中，结合轨迹和仅状态评判器可召回94%的已确认伤害，而仅轨迹评判器为53%。在OS-Harm上，联合召回率为77%，而仅轨迹评判器为67%。同时获得两个通道的单一评判器表现并不更好，并且比仅状态评判器产生更多的假阴性。我们还记录了分歧，发现这两个通道遗漏了不同的事件。这些结果表明，结合两个特定通道评判器的裁决是在智能体环境中检测和验证伤害的一种稳健且灵活的方法。
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合轨迹和环境状态双通道LLM评判器的方法，通过分别评估智能体行为记录和最终环境状态，显著提高了在智能体环境中检测和验证伤害的召回率。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全评估方法在检测智能体造成的伤害时存在局限，通常仅依赖轨迹评估或最终状态的确定性检查，且现有的基于LLM的环境验证器主要用于任务完成度验证而非伤害检测，缺乏对双通道伤害证据的全面利用。
AI.method: 引入一个具有环境状态只读访问权限并配备伤害分类体系的LLM作为状态评判器。在DecodingTrust-Arena和OSWorld环境中进行实验，固定评判模型和分类体系，对比仅轨迹评判、仅状态评判以及两者结合（双通道独立评判器联合）的伤害检测效果。
AI.result: 在DecodingTrust-Arena中，双通道联合评判召回了94%的已确认伤害（仅轨迹为53%）；在OS-Harm中联合召回率为77%（仅轨迹为67%）。单一模型同时处理双通道的效果不如独立的双通道评判器，且假阴性更多。两个通道遗漏的伤害事件各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 结合两个特定通道（轨迹和状态）独立评判器的裁决，是在智能体环境中检测和验证伤害的一种稳健且灵活的有效方法。

summary: Progress in AI is often measured by what a single model can do on its own. Yet teams of AI agents are starting to make breakthroughs and discoveries in science, medicine, mathematics and software engineering. As AI begins to work in teams of agents and people, the ability to collaborate becomes a core part of their intelligence. Research on human teams has measured this ability for decades. Inspired by this, we introduce the Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark, which measures how well an AI agent works as a teammate. It contains 240 tasks across 8 dimensions of teamwork, from refusing an unsafe shortcut to checking the work that a weaker model leaves behind. Each task comes from a real record or an existing benchmark, from aviation accident reports and clinical cases to coding tasks and negotiations, and has a programmatically verifiable outcome. To isolate teamwork from individual capability, models are scored only on tasks that they can solve by themselves when they have full information. We evaluate 18 closed- and open-weight models and find that every model, across sizes and families, has clear weaknesses as a teammate, with the best model scoring only 82.2 out of 100. Frontier models almost always refuse unsafe shortcuts and report misconduct, yet they cave under interpersonal pressure, reaching the best overall deal in only 14% of conflicts, and their pass rate drops from 97% to 81% when they take over a task in which a weaker model has cheated. Crucially, general capability does not guarantee good teamwork, as models with nearly the same capability score differ by up to 11 points as teammates. The benchmark includes 160 public tasks with code and data, along with 80 held-out tasks for evaluation. As AI agents increasingly work alongside other agents and people, the ability to collaborate effectively is becoming a crucial capability to measure and develop.
title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence

selection.reason_zh: 提出评估AI agent协作能力的benchmark，涉及多agent协作、团队任务与代码任务评测。

AI.abstract_zh: 人工智能的进展通常通过单个模型独立完成任务的能力来衡量。然而，人工智能代理团队开始在科学、医学、数学和软件工程领域取得突破和发现。随着人工智能开始以代理和人类团队的形式工作，协作能力成为其智能的核心部分。关于人类团队的研究几十年来一直在衡量这种能力。受此启发，我们引入了协作智能基准，用于衡量人工智能代理作为团队成员的表现。它包含240个任务，涵盖团队合作的8个维度，从拒绝不安全的捷径到检查较弱模型留下的工作。每个任务都来自真实记录或现有基准，从航空事故报告和临床案例到编码任务和谈判，并且具有可通过编程验证的结果。为了将团队合作能力与个人能力隔离开来，模型仅在它们拥有完整信息时能够独立解决的任务上进行评分。我们评估了18个闭权重和开权重模型，发现每个模型（无论规模大小和家族）作为团队成员都有明显的弱点，表现最好的模型得分也仅为100分中的82.2分。前沿模型几乎总是拒绝不安全的捷径并报告不当行为，但它们在人际压力下会妥协，在冲突中仅14%的情况能达成最佳整体交易，当它们接手较弱模型作弊的任务时，通过率从97%下降到81%。至关重要的是，通用能力并不能保证良好的团队合作，因为能力得分几乎相同的模型作为团队成员的得分差异高达11分。该基准包括160个包含代码和数据的公开任务，以及80个用于评估的保留任务。随着人工智能代理越来越多地与其他代理和人类并肩工作，有效协作的能力正成为一项需要衡量和发展的关键能力。
AI.tldr: 本文提出协作智能基准（CIB），包含240个任务以评估AI代理的团队协作能力。对18个模型的评估表明，尽管前沿模型能拒绝不安全行为，但在人际压力和应对队友作弊时表现不佳，且通用能力无法保证良好的团队合作。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理开始在多智能体和人类团队中协作，协作能力成为其智能的核心。现有评估多关注单模型能力，受人类团队协作研究的启发，亟需建立系统性标准来衡量AI代理作为团队成员的协作能力。
AI.method: 提出协作智能基准（CIB），包含8个维度的240个任务（160个公开，80个保留），任务源自真实记录或现有基准且结果可编程验证。为隔离个人能力，仅在模型具备完整信息且能独立解决的任务上进行评分，并据此评估了18个闭权重和开权重模型。

AI.conclusion: 随着AI代理日益与人类及其他代理协同工作，有效协作已成为一项至关重要的能力，未来需要对其进行重点衡量与开发。

summary: An indirect prompt injection can affect a search-augmented large language model only after its carrier page reaches model context. SearchInject controls this admission decision with a joint score combining retrieval relevance, search-abuse cues, instruction likelihood, and two relevance interactions. A quarantine threshold is selected under an empirical 0.5% clean-candidate false-quarantine constraint on a calibration split. Evaluation uses 300 held-out SciFact queries and held-out payload categories within four construction families already represented during development. Across 1,200 query-family outcomes per retriever, top-10 target exposure falls from 0.9408 to 0.1583 for BM25, from 0.9158 to 0.1508 for a normalized hybrid, and from 0.8450 to 0.1375 for latent semantic analysis. These are relative reductions of 83.2-83.7%; the largest absolute change in clean normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 is 0.0018. The frozen threshold yields clean test false-quarantine rates of 0.59-0.65%, above the empirical calibration constraint. A query-level analytical reanalysis accounts for the repeated construction outcomes under an independent-query assumption. A separate 104-case generation follow-up records context removal but no confirmed undefended hijacks under a post hoc endpoint, so it cannot estimate a reduction in attack success. The evidence supports retrieval exposure control within the evaluated construction families; the benefit of the interaction terms at matched clean cost remains unresolved.
title: SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search

selection.reason_zh: 研究搜索增强LLM的间接提示注入防御，属于agent可靠性与安全控制范畴。

AI.abstract_zh: 间接提示注入只有在载体页面进入模型上下文后，才能影响搜索增强的大型语言模型。SearchInject通过结合检索相关性、搜索滥用线索、指令似然性以及两个相关性交互作用的联合分数来控制这一准入决策。在校准划分上，在经验上0.5%的干净候选误隔离约束下选择隔离阈值。评估使用300个保留的SciFact查询以及开发期间已代表的四个构建族中的保留有效载荷类别。在每个检索器的1,200个查询-族结果中，BM25的top-10目标暴露率从0.9408降至0.1583，归一化混合检索从0.9158降至0.1508，潜在语义分析从0.8450降至0.1375。这些是83.2-83.7%的相对减少；在排名10处，干净归一化折扣累积增益的最大绝对变化为0.0018。冻结阈值产生的干净测试误隔离率为0.59-0.65%，高于经验校准约束。在独立查询假设下，查询级分析重新分析解释了重复的构建结果。一个单独的104例生成后续研究记录了上下文移除，但在事后端点下没有确认的未防御劫持，因此无法估计攻击成功率的降低。证据支持在评估的构建族内进行检索暴露控制；在匹配的干净成本下交互项的益处仍未解决。
AI.tldr: 本文提出SearchInject方法，通过联合评分机制控制搜索增强大语言模型的上下文准入，有效降低了间接提示注入攻击中的目标暴露率，同时保持了对干净查询的检索性能。
AI.motivation: 间接提示注入攻击依赖载体页面进入模型上下文，需要一种机制在检索阶段控制上下文准入，以防御此类攻击并保护搜索增强的大语言模型。
AI.method: 提出SearchInject方法，利用结合检索相关性、搜索滥用线索、指令似然性及相关性交互的联合分数来控制准入决策。通过在校准集上施加0.5%的干净候选误隔离约束来确定隔离阈值，并在多个检索器和构建族上进行评估。
AI.result: 在1200个查询-族结果中，BM25、归一化混合检索和潜在语义分析的top-10目标暴露率分别相对降低了83.2%-83.7%。排名10处的干净归一化折扣累积增益最大绝对变化仅为0.0018。冻结阈值的干净测试误隔离率为0.59%-0.65%。104例生成后续研究记录了上下文移除，但未确认未防御劫持。
AI.conclusion: 证据表明SearchInject能有效控制评估构建族内的检索暴露，但在匹配干净成本的情况下，交互项的具体收益仍有待进一步研究。

comment: 31 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Benchmark: https://cadbench.ai/ ; tasks and leaderboard: https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/gnucleus-ai/cad-bench/v3 ; scoring code: https://github.com/gNucleus-AI/freecad-validator
summary: Producing an executable CAD script is not sufficient to establish that an agent has satisfied an engineering design request. Evaluation must also consider the resulting geometry, specified dimensions, and native CAD modeling history. We present Parametric CAD Bench v3, a 100-task benchmark comprising 30 text-to-CAD creation tasks, 30 text-to-CAD create-and-edit tasks, and 40 tasks that reconstruct mechanical parts from engineering drawings. Agents operate in a pinned FreeCAD environment and submit native CAD artifacts to a separate programmatic verifier. The primary metric is mean continuous task reward, combining geometry similarity and specification consistency rather than binary task success. A September 24, 2026 snapshot covers 13 model-agent systems; Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest overall point estimate, 61.03%, and an image-to-CAD mean reward of 84.66%. These measurements describe complete systems, not isolated model capabilities. We release versioned tasks, evaluation configurations, and inspectable result artifacts.
title: Parametric CAD Bench v3: Evaluating Agentic Parametric CAD Authoring from Text and Engineering Drawings
